entries.zh: 程序化 SEO 批处理：运行文章批次、跟踪状态并导出 Markdown，同时提供主题集群、FAQ schema 和元描述工具。

entries.english: Trace how a product grew from public sources with dated, linked evidence, plus Search Console data, site audits and a dofollow directory list.
entries.zh: 通过标明日期和链接的公开证据追踪产品增长历程，同时提供 Search Console 数据、网站审计和 dofollow 目录列表。

entries.english: Local dashboard for Claude Code and Codex token usage: cost, per-MCP and per-tool breakdown, hourly distribution and session drill-down.
entries.zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 的本地 token 用量仪表板：费用、按 MCP 与工具细分、小时分布和会话明细。

entries.english: Read-only, self-hosted access to the Apple Search Ads API.
entries.zh: 以自托管方式只读访问 Apple Search Ads API。

entries.english: MarkItUp image annotation and marketing visuals: generate visuals from screenshots with templates, regenerate, outpaint and remove backgrounds.
entries.zh: MarkItUp 图片标注与营销视觉：使用模板从截图生成视觉素材，并支持重新生成、扩图和移除背景。

entries.english: Apple Ads (formerly Apple Search Ads) Campaign Management API: campaigns, ad groups, ads, creatives, keywords, reports, budget orders and multi-org support.
entries.zh: Apple Ads（原 Apple Search Ads）Campaign Management API：支持广告系列、广告组、广告、创意、关键词、报告、预算订单和多组织。

entries.english: Google Ad Manager campaign management, line items, creatives, reporting, inventory exploration and ad-ops compliance audits.
entries.zh: 管理 Google Ad Manager 广告系列、订单项和创意，提供报告、库存探索和广告运营合规审计。

entries.english: Search marketing agencies and get matched with suitable ones via Pick an Agency.
entries.zh: 通过 Pick an Agency 搜索营销机构，并匹配合适的机构。

entries.english: Technical SEO audits: health score, categorized issues and an AI search visibility score, plus robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD and meta tag validators.
entries.zh: 技术 SEO 审计：健康评分、分类问题和 AI 搜索可见度评分，以及 robots.txt、站点地图、JSON-LD 和 meta 标签验证器。

entries.english: Read-only SEO servers for the Google and Yandex (RU/CIS) market: XMLStock SERP, Yandex Wordstat, Google Search Console, Yandex.Webmaster and Yandex.Metrica.
entries.zh: 面向 Google 和 Yandex（俄罗斯及独联体）市场的只读 SEO 服务器：XMLStock SERP、Yandex Wordstat、Google Search Console、Yandex.Webmaster 和 Yandex.Metrica。

entries.english: AEO and GEO audits for public URLs: schema.org, robots.txt, llms.txt, canonical and OpenGraph checks, AI-citation likelihood and suggested rewrites.
entries.zh: 针对公开 URL 的 AEO 和 GEO 审计：检查 schema.org、robots.txt、llms.txt、canonical 和 OpenGraph，评估被 AI 引用的可能性并提供改写建议。

entries.english: Revenue platform for outbound, deals, pipeline and CRM automation, with people, outreach, engagement and research tools.
entries.zh: 用于外联、交易、销售管道和 CRM 自动化的收入平台，提供人员、外联、互动及研究工具。

entries.english: Pay-per-call SEO and AI visibility checks via x402 on Solana: keyword research, on-page audits, AI-citation checks, and rank, SERP, domain and backlink data.
entries.zh: 通过 Solana 上的 x402 按次付费进行 SEO 和 AI 可见度检查：关键词研究、页面审计、AI 引用检查以及排名、SERP、域名和反向链接数据。

entries.english: Hosted Google Ads: read-only queries, keyword research and approved changes, from negatives and budgets to building Search, Performance Max, Display and YouTube campaigns, each logged with undo. No developer token.
entries.zh: 托管 Google Ads：只读查询、关键词研究以及经批准的更改，涵盖否定关键词、预算及创建搜索、Performance Max、展示和 YouTube 广告系列；每次操作均有日志并可撤销，无需开发者令牌。

entries.english: Crawl your site, find gaps in AI answers, generate meta, schema and content fixes and ship them as PRs, with DataForSEO keyword and Search Console data.
entries.zh: 抓取网站、发现 AI 回答中的缺口、生成 meta、schema 和内容修复，并以 PR 提交；使用 DataForSEO 关键词与 Search Console 数据。

entries.english: Audit YouTube scripts before recording: hook, structure and pacing scores, drop-off passages, policy and inauthentic-content checks, and runtime estimates.
entries.zh: 录制前审计 YouTube 脚本：开头吸引力、结构和节奏评分、观众流失片段、政策及非原创内容检查、时长估计。

entries.english: Tells AI agents what changed across VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs and VictoriaTraces, and where it started: a ranked, token-budgeted digest that separates root causes from echoes using trace structure.
entries.zh: 告知 AI 智能体 VictoriaMetrics、VictoriaLogs 和 VictoriaTraces 中发生了什么变化及其起点：利用追踪结构区分根因与连带现象，生成按优先级排序且受 token 预算约束的摘要。

entries.english: Safe-by-default MCP server for Grafana: search & read dashboards and the dashboard JSON model, query datasources (Prometheus/Loki/SQL via the unified query API), and inspect alert rules & annotations; in higher modes, create/update dashboards and folders, write annotations, and delete. Read-only by default with access modes, folder/datasource allowlists, and human confirmation (MCP elicitation) on deletes. `npx -y @dockndevai/mcp-grafana`
entries.zh: 默认安全的 Grafana MCP 服务器：搜索和读取仪表板及其 JSON 模型，查询数据源（通过统一查询 API 使用 Prometheus/Loki/SQL），检查告警规则与注释；更高权限模式可创建／更新仪表板和文件夹、写入注释及删除。默认只读，提供访问模式、文件夹／数据源允许列表，并在删除时要求人工确认（MCP elicitation）。`npx -y @dockndevai/mcp-grafana`

entries.english: Google CrUX: real-user Core Web Vitals with mobile and desktop comparison and 40-week trends.
entries.zh: Google CrUX：真实用户的 Core Web Vitals，支持移动端与桌面端比较及 40 周趋势。

entries.english: Inspect local JSONL and OTLP JSON agent traces through MCP: failures, approvals, token usage, and run comparisons. `uvx spanhound`
entries.zh: 通过 MCP 检查本地 JSONL 和 OTLP JSON 智能体追踪：失败、审批、token 用量及运行比较。`uvx spanhound`

entries.english: Fingerprints, graphs and watches the live infrastructure an agent can reach (Docker, Kubernetes, cloud, IaC) and detects incidents.
entries.zh: 对智能体可访问的实时基础设施（Docker、Kubernetes、云和 IaC）建立指纹、图谱并持续监视，检测事故。

entries.english: Tamper-evident AI agent observability: hash-chained audit log with verification and signed export (EU AI Act Art. 12), plus OpenTelemetry GenAI traces.
entries.zh: 防篡改 AI 智能体可观测性：提供可验证、可签名导出的哈希链审计日志（欧盟 AI 法案第 12 条）和 OpenTelemetry GenAI 追踪。

entries.english: Endpoint fleet operations (thin client, VDI): login-storm and patch/config-drift analysis, inventory, and guarded remediation with audit logs and rollback.
entries.zh: 终端设备群运维（瘦客户端、VDI）：分析登录风暴及补丁／配置漂移，提供资产清单和带审计日志与回滚的受控修复。

entries.english: Read-only access to OpenObserve Community Edition: search logs, traces, stream schemas and dashboards without an Enterprise license.
entries.zh: 只读访问 OpenObserve Community Edition：无需企业许可证即可搜索日志、追踪、流 schema 和仪表板。

entries.english: AI agent activity logging and monitoring on the Alog platform: post logs, create articles, manage social interactions and monitor agent activity.
entries.zh: 在 Alog 平台记录并监控 AI 智能体活动：发布日志、创建文章、管理社交互动及监测智能体活动。

entries.english: Read-only Loggly search and analytics with aggregation-first traffic tools and IP intelligence (RDAP, GreyNoise, AbuseIPDB).
entries.zh: 只读 Loggly 搜索和分析，提供以聚合为优先的流量工具及 IP 情报（RDAP、GreyNoise、AbuseIPDB）。

entries.english: Read-only Redis monitoring: queue depths, Celery queue status, connected clients, server and memory stats, and key counts per database.
entries.zh: 只读 Redis 监控：队列深度、Celery 队列状态、已连接客户端、服务器和内存统计，以及各数据库的键数量。

entries.english: Observability for AI agents: LLM cost, errors and latency across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Mistral, plus alerts, budget gates, evals and safety checks.
entries.zh: AI 智能体可观测性：覆盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 和 Mistral 的 LLM 成本、错误和延迟，并提供告警、预算门槛、评估及安全检查。

entries.english: Live telemetry for MCP servers: instrument tool calls and stream their progress (steps, logs, cost) to any connected MCP client, even across sessions.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器实时遥测：对工具调用进行检测并将进度（步骤、日志、成本）流式发送给任何已连接的 MCP 客户端，支持跨会话。

entries.english: Measures Claude Code session efficiency: the share of tokens that became output versus re-read context, by tokens and cost, from local transcripts.
entries.zh: 根据本地记录衡量 Claude Code 会话效率：按 token 数量和费用计算转化为输出的 token 与重新读取上下文的占比。

entries.english: Query Langfuse traces, debug exceptions, analyze sessions and manage prompts for LLM applications.
entries.zh: 查询 Langfuse 追踪、调试异常、分析会话，并管理 LLM 应用的提示词。

entries.english: Observability across Grafana, Prometheus, Kafka UI and Datadog using your own keys.
entries.zh: 使用自己的密钥，对 Grafana、Prometheus、Kafka UI 和 Datadog 提供可观测性。

entries.english: Monitor cron jobs, backups, Kubernetes jobs and other scheduled tasks in Watchgoose. Read-only by default; check changes require explicit consent.
entries.zh: 在 Watchgoose 中监控 cron 作业、备份、Kubernetes 作业及其他定时任务。默认只读；更改检查项须经明确同意。

entries.english: Postfix delivery troubleshooting: queue grouped by deferral reason, qshape, mail log stats and traces, SPF/DKIM/DMARC/PTR checks. Read-only by default; requeue/flush/delete need an opt-in flag.
entries.zh: 排查 Postfix 投递问题：按延迟原因分组队列、qshape、邮件日志统计和追踪、SPF/DKIM/DMARC/PTR 检查。默认只读；重新入队、刷新或删除需要主动启用标志。

entries.english: Runtime guardrails and incident read access for coding agents: query AgentGuard traces, alerts, usage, costs and budget health.
entries.zh: 面向编码智能体的运行时防护和事故只读访问：查询 AgentGuard 追踪、告警、用量、成本及预算健康情况。

entries.english: Web analytics: query pageviews, top pages, referrers, countries, devices and custom events, and create conversion funnels and alerts.
entries.zh: 网页分析：查询浏览量、热门页面、来源、国家、设备和自定义事件，并创建转化漏斗与告警。

entries.english: Rule-based cloud cost anomaly detection and architecture risk scoring (single points of failure, coupling, scalability gaps) with rule-by-rule breakdowns.
entries.zh: 基于规则的云成本异常检测与架构风险评分（单点故障、耦合、扩展性缺口），提供逐条规则明细。

entries.english: Local, payload-free AI cost visibility for agents. Track spend by model, route, customer, or tagged work without storing prompt or response bodies.
entries.zh: 本地、无需保存载荷的智能体 AI 成本可见度：按模型、路由、客户或带标签的工作跟踪支出，不存储提示词或响应正文。

entries.english: Local system monitoring (CPU, memory, swap, disk, network) and process management: find resource-hungry processes, diagnose slowdowns and kill processes.
entries.zh: 本地系统监控（CPU、内存、交换空间、磁盘、网络）和进程管理：查找资源消耗高的进程、诊断性能下降并终止进程。

entries.english: Interact with Edge Delta anomalies, query logs, patterns and events, find root causes and optimize pipelines.
entries.zh: 与 Edge Delta 异常交互，查询日志、模式和事件，寻找根因并优化流水线。

entries.english: Network and proxy diagnostics: GitHub reachability, system proxy status, local proxy port probing, DNS/TCP/HTTP checks, hosts conflict scan, and a doctor that suggests what to change.
entries.zh: 网络与代理诊断：检查 GitHub 可达性、系统代理状态、本地代理端口、DNS/TCP/HTTP，扫描 hosts 冲突，并提供建议更改项的诊断工具。

entries.english: Unified work logging and observability across AI agents, with config-first schemas and pluggable sinks.
entries.zh: 跨 AI 智能体统一记录工作和提供可观测性，采用配置优先的 schema 和可插拔输出端。

entries.english: Transparent MCP proxy that intercepts JSON-RPC messages, measures latency, stores traces in SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL, and exports OpenTelemetry spans.
entries.zh: 透明 MCP 代理：拦截 JSON-RPC 消息、测量延迟、将追踪存入 SQLite、PostgreSQL 或 MySQL，并导出 OpenTelemetry span。

entries.english: Monitors public web pages (pricing, policy, changelog) for changes and returns evidence receipts with source URLs, content hashes and change history. Remote MCP server; free plan: 1 source checked daily for 30 days.
entries.zh: 监控公开网页（价格、政策、更新日志）的变化，返回包含来源 URL、内容哈希及变更历史的证据记录。远程 MCP 服务器；免费计划为 1 个来源每天检查一次，持续 30 天。

entries.english: Read-only access to on-prem Linux VMs and PostgreSQL over SSH: service health, logs, database state and table schemas, with allowlists and an audit log.
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 只读访问本地 Linux 虚拟机和 PostgreSQL：查看服务健康、日志、数据库状态与表结构，提供允许列表和审计日志。

entries.english: Cross-agent failure intelligence: before retrying a failed tool call, check whether other agents hit the same failure and which recovery worked.
entries.zh: 跨智能体故障情报：重试失败的工具调用前，检查其他智能体是否遇到相同故障及哪种恢复方式有效。

entries.english: Uptime monitoring over MCP. List and create checks, read incidents and results, manage maintenance windows and status pages. Self-hosted single Go binary, 40 check types, probes in several regions.
entries.zh: 通过 MCP 监控可用性：列出和创建检查、读取事故与结果、管理维护窗口及状态页。自托管单个 Go 二进制，支持 40 种检查类型和多个地区的探针。

entries.english: Sentry integration for error tracking and performance monitoring.
entries.zh: 集成 Sentry 进行错误跟踪和性能监控。

entries.english: Duplicacy backup monitoring: query backup job status and Prometheus metrics from a Duplicacy exporter.
entries.zh: 监控 Duplicacy 备份：从 Duplicacy exporter 查询备份作业状态与 Prometheus 指标。

entries.english: Bridge to GenieACS (TR-069 ACS) instances: device data, firmware management and CPE actions such as reboot, parameter refresh and firmware download.
entries.zh: 连接 GenieACS（TR-069 ACS）实例：提供设备数据、固件管理，以及重启、刷新参数、下载固件等 CPE 操作。

entries.english: Unofficial FortiMonitor v2 API integration for server monitoring, outages, maintenance, metrics and notifications.
entries.zh: 非官方 FortiMonitor v2 API 集成，用于服务器监控、停机、维护、指标和通知。

entries.english: Webmin Linux system administration: services, users, storage, security, databases and more.
entries.zh: Webmin Linux 系统管理：服务、用户、存储、安全、数据库等。

entries.english: Server operations locally or over SSH: log troubleshooting, CPU, memory and disk monitoring, code edits, and Nginx and certificate management.
entries.zh: 在本地或通过 SSH 进行服务器运维：排查日志、监控 CPU／内存／磁盘、编辑代码，以及管理 Nginx 和证书。

entries.english: Website uptime monitoring: instant HTTP, ping, port, DNS, WHOIS, blacklist and page-speed checks, plus monitors, webhooks, incidents and status pages.
entries.zh: 网站可用性监控：即时检查 HTTP、ping、端口、DNS、WHOIS、黑名单和页面速度，并提供监控器、webhook、事故与状态页。

entries.english: Read access to the Langfuse Public API: traces, observations, sessions, scores, prompts, datasets, metrics, models, projects and comments.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Langfuse Public API：追踪、观察、会话、评分、提示词、数据集、指标、模型、项目及评论。

entries.english: Agent evaluation and observability: trace logging, output quality evaluation, cost tracking, built-in eval rules, a real-time dashboard and PII detection.
entries.zh: 智能体评估与可观测性：追踪日志、输出质量评估、成本跟踪、内置评估规则、实时仪表板和个人身份信息检测。

entries.english: Monitor the operational status of major digital platforms.
entries.zh: 监控主要数字平台的运行状态。

entries.english: Debug container and Kubernetes workloads with eBPF via Inspektor Gadget.
entries.zh: 通过 Inspektor Gadget 使用 eBPF 调试容器和 Kubernetes 工作负载。

entries.english: Check whether software services are down using live data from their status pages, including incident details.
entries.zh: 利用软件服务状态页的实时数据检查服务是否宕机，包括事故详情。

entries.english: Read-only health checks for a local vLLM instance: liveness and real-completion tiers, GPU and VRAM status, service status and serve-flag introspection.
entries.zh: 本地 vLLM 实例只读健康检查：存活与真实补全两个级别，GPU 和显存状态、服务状态及启动参数检查。

entries.english: Synthetic monitoring for cloud and local LLM inference endpoints: TTFT, latency, throughput and errors, with Prometheus and OpenTelemetry export.
entries.zh: 对云端和本地 LLM 推理端点进行合成监控：TTFT、延迟、吞吐和错误，并可导出 Prometheus 和 OpenTelemetry 数据。

entries.english: Read-only access to whitelisted log files on a Linux server: search and read logs without shell access, with token auth and syslog auditing.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Linux 服务器上允许列表内的日志文件：无需 shell 即可搜索和读取日志，支持 token 认证与 syslog 审计。

entries.english: Bring real-time production logs, metrics and traces from Last9 into your local environment to fix code.
entries.zh: 将 Last9 的实时生产日志、指标和追踪引入本地环境，用于修复代码。

entries.english: Dead man's switch monitoring for AI agents, cron jobs and CI/CD pipelines: alerts when runs go silent, stall, fail or loop, with incident details.
entries.zh: 为 AI 智能体、cron 作业和 CI/CD 流水线提供失联监控：运行无响应、停滞、失败或循环时发出告警，并提供事故详情。

entries.english: Read-only Tautulli (Plex monitoring) access: activity, history, library and user stats, transcode analysis and resolution breakdowns.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Tautulli（Plex 监控）：活动、历史、媒体库及用户统计、转码分析和分辨率细分。

entries.english: Rank log patterns by volume and cost, then compact (Splunk, self-managed Elasticsearch), tier down or offload the excess over each cap. Runs locally; no log data reaches log10x.
entries.zh: 按数量和成本排列日志模式，再对超出各限额的部分进行压缩（Splunk、自管理 Elasticsearch）、降层或卸载。本地运行；日志数据不会发送到 log10x。

entries.english: Query Langfuse traces and observations, debug exceptions, analyze sessions, scores and datasets, and manage prompts.
entries.zh: 查询 Langfuse 追踪和观察、调试异常、分析会话、评分及数据集，并管理提示词。

entries.english: Local cost tracking for Claude Code and Codex sessions: spend by session, sub-agent and model, week-on-week comparisons, and findings with suggested patches.
entries.zh: 本地跟踪 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话成本：按会话、子智能体和模型统计支出、周环比，并提供带建议补丁的发现结果。

entries.english: Access the Umami Analytics API: websites, stats, sessions, events, reports, users, teams and realtime monitoring.
entries.zh: 访问 Umami Analytics API：网站、统计、会话、事件、报告、用户、团队及实时监控。

entries.english: Agent observability platform that discovers and recommends MCP servers, with GA4, Vercel, GitHub and Sentry connectors and ROI tracking.
entries.zh: 发现并推荐 MCP 服务器的智能体可观测性平台，提供 GA4、Vercel、GitHub 和 Sentry 连接器及投资回报跟踪。

entries.english: Query the local Agentic Ledger flight recorder: agent sessions, costs, loop runs and stuck-loop flags captured by a transparent proxy.
entries.zh: 查询本地 Agentic Ledger 飞行记录器：由透明代理捕获的智能体会话、成本、循环运行和卡死循环标记。

entries.english: Read-only access to a local dev bench that interleaves every log stream on one timeline: tail and search live streams, search the on-disk journal, wait for an event, and read per-topic guides for unfamiliar topics. No API key, no daemon of its own, `npx -y @super-log/mcp`.
entries.zh: 只读访问本地开发工作台，该工作台将所有日志流交织在同一时间线上：跟踪和搜索实时流、搜索磁盘日志、等待事件，以及阅读陌生主题的分主题指南。无需 API 密钥，也没有自己的守护进程。`npx -y @super-log/mcp`

entries.english: Track agent tool spending with local, consent-gated JSONL storage.
entries.zh: 使用本地、经用户同意才启用的 JSONL 存储跟踪智能体工具支出。

entries.english: AI API cost tracking and budget enforcement across LLM providers: spend analytics, budget monitoring, session summaries and key management.
entries.zh: 跨 LLM 服务商跟踪 AI API 成本并执行预算限制：支出分析、预算监控、会话摘要和密钥管理。

entries.english: Measure whether a Claude subscription pays off from local Claude Code logs: surviving Claude-written code, rate-limit drivers and chat usage.
entries.zh: 基于本地 Claude Code 日志衡量 Claude 订阅是否划算：保留下来的 Claude 编写代码、触发速率限制的原因和聊天用量。

entries.english: AI agent cost tracking: spend across providers, model selection optimization, budget enforcement, cost-leak detection and ROI reporting.
entries.zh: AI 智能体成本跟踪：跨服务商支出、模型选择优化、预算执行、成本泄漏检测及投资回报报告。

entries.english: Privacy-first web analytics: query pageviews, referrers, trends and AI-generated insights for your sites.
entries.zh: 隐私优先的网页分析：查询网站浏览量、来源、趋势和 AI 生成的洞察。

entries.english: Real-time cost observability for MCP tool calls: a transparent proxy that attributes spend per tool, project and end customer.
entries.zh: MCP 工具调用实时成本可观测性：透明代理按工具、项目和最终客户归集支出。

entries.english: Zabbix integration for hosts, items, triggers, templates, problems, data and more.
entries.zh: 集成 Zabbix，访问主机、监控项、触发器、模板、问题、数据等。

entries.english: Discovery, exploration, reporting and root cause analysis over Netdata metrics, logs, systems, containers, processes and network connections.
entries.zh: 针对 Netdata 指标、日志、系统、容器、进程及网络连接进行发现、探索、报告和根因分析。

entries.english: Healthchecks cron and uptime monitoring: see which scheduled jobs are late or down, read the output a failing job reported with its ping, and create, pause or adjust checks. Works against healthchecks.io or a self-hosted instance. `npx -y healthchecks-mcp`
entries.zh: Healthchecks cron 和可用性监控：查看哪些定时任务延迟或停止、读取失败任务随 ping 报告的输出，以及创建、暂停或调整检查。支持 healthchecks.io 或自托管实例。`npx -y healthchecks-mcp`

entries.english: Query, summarize and trace logs in plain English across GCP Cloud Logging, AWS CloudWatch, Azure Log Analytics, Grafana Loki and Elasticsearch.
entries.zh: 用自然语言跨 GCP Cloud Logging、AWS CloudWatch、Azure Log Analytics、Grafana Loki 和 Elasticsearch 查询、总结并追踪日志。

entries.english: Access openITCOCKPIT monitoring: host and service state, check history, logs, downtimes, acknowledgements, software inventory and pending security updates.
entries.zh: 访问 openITCOCKPIT 监控：主机和服务状态、检查历史、日志、停机、确认记录、软件清单及待处理安全更新。

entries.english: Homelab management across multiple servers via SSH: system resource monitoring, Docker containers, Wake-on-LAN, network scans, open-port checks and alerts.
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 跨多个服务器管理家庭实验室：监控系统资源、Docker 容器、网络唤醒、网络扫描、开放端口检查和告警。

entries.english: Query Grafana Loki directly with a discovery-first workflow: labels, values, series and LogQL queries, without requiring Grafana.
entries.zh: 以发现优先的工作流直接查询 Grafana Loki：标签、值、时间序列和 LogQL 查询，无需 Grafana。

entries.english: Read-only Grafana Loki (2.6.1 and 3.x) for agents: label and stream discovery, bounded LogQL pages, counts by label or time bucket, and log export; several stands per server.
entries.zh: 面向智能体的只读 Grafana Loki（2.6.1 和 3.x）：发现标签和流、分页查询有界 LogQL、按标签或时间桶计数及导出日志；每个服务器可连接多个实例。

entries.english: Read-only data quality monitoring for Postgres, BigQuery, Snowflake, MySQL and DuckDB: warehouse profiling, anomaly detection and optional dbt lineage.
entries.zh: 只读监控 Postgres、BigQuery、Snowflake、MySQL 和 DuckDB 数据质量：仓库剖析、异常检测和可选 dbt 血缘。

entries.english: Read-only access to Spanlens LLM observability: request logs, costs, agent traces, anomalies, model savings and per-user analytics.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Spanlens LLM 可观测性数据：请求日志、成本、智能体追踪、异常、模型节省及按用户分析。

entries.english: Data freshness verification: probe endpoints for cache staleness, latency, content fingerprints, TLS, DNS and redirects, with FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN verdicts.
entries.zh: 验证数据新鲜度：探测端点的缓存过期情况、延迟、内容指纹、TLS、DNS 和重定向，返回 FRESH／STALE／UNKNOWN 判定。

entries.english: Check the real-time operational status of cloud services and APIs such as AWS, GitHub, Stripe, OpenAI and Vercel.
entries.zh: 检查 AWS、GitHub、Stripe、OpenAI 和 Vercel 等云服务及 API 的实时运行状态。

entries.english: Cookieless web analytics with Gizmo Analytics: framework-aware setup, traffic queries, site summaries, traffic-change explanations and anomaly detection.
entries.zh: 使用 Gizmo Analytics 进行无 cookie 网页分析：支持识别框架的设置、流量查询、网站摘要、流量变化解释和异常检测。

entries.english: Datadog observability: grep-like log search, APM trace filtering by duration, status and errors, sampling modes, and log, trace and metric correlation.
entries.zh: Datadog 可观测性：类似 grep 的日志搜索、按时长／状态／错误筛选 APM 追踪、采样模式，以及日志、追踪和指标关联。

entries.english: ThinkNEO Control Plane for enterprise AI governance: runtime guardrails, observability, AI FinOps and agent lifecycle control.
entries.zh: 面向企业 AI 治理的 ThinkNEO 控制平面：运行时防护、可观测性、AI FinOps 和智能体生命周期控制。

entries.english: HTTP uptime monitoring, heartbeat (dead man's switch) monitoring, cron job scheduling and email verification.
entries.zh: HTTP 可用性监控、心跳（失联开关）监控、cron 作业调度和邮箱验证。

entries.english: Uptime monitoring for websites, APIs, SSL certificates, domain expiry, ping and TCP/UDP ports: manage monitors and view incidents and uptime history.
entries.zh: 监控网站、API、SSL 证书、域名到期、ping 及 TCP/UDP 端口的可用性：管理监控项并查看事故和可用性历史。

entries.english: Minimal Sentry integration.
entries.zh: 精简的 Sentry 集成。

entries.english: Datadog observability: metrics, monitors, logs, APM, RUM, incidents, status pages, fleet automation and workflows, plus incident-triage prompts.
entries.zh: Datadog 可观测性：指标、监控器、日志、APM、RUM、事故、状态页、设备群自动化及工作流，并提供事故分诊提示词。

entries.english: Website audits: SEO, security headers and SSL, Lighthouse performance, broken links, WCAG accessibility, Schema.org validation, competitor gaps and robots.txt.
entries.zh: 网站审计：SEO、安全响应头和 SSL、Lighthouse 性能、失效链接、WCAG 无障碍、Schema.org 验证、竞争差距及 robots.txt。

entries.english: Google PageSpeed Insights, CrUX and Lighthouse analysis: page comparison, real-user data, batch runs, regression tracking, diagnostics and recommendations.
entries.zh: Google PageSpeed Insights、CrUX 和 Lighthouse 分析：页面比较、真实用户数据、批量运行、回归跟踪、诊断及建议。

entries.english: Website monitoring that catches pages that look broken even when the site is up (uptime, performance, SSL, DNS, visual regression, content change). 17 tools: DNS lookup, SSL inspection, speed test, website check and service health work without an account; monitor, incident, alert, status-page and server tools need a Visual Sentinel API key (Business and Agency plans). Published as `@visualsentinel/mcp-server` on npm.
entries.zh: 网站监控：即使网站在线，也能发现外观异常的页面，覆盖可用性、性能、SSL、DNS、视觉回归和内容变化。17 个工具中，DNS 查询、SSL 检查、速度测试、网站检查和服务健康无需账户；监控、事故、告警、状态页及服务器工具需要 Visual Sentinel API 密钥（Business 和 Agency 计划）。npm 包名为 `@visualsentinel/mcp-server`。

entries.english: Prometheus integration.
entries.zh: Prometheus 集成。

entries.english: Local LLM API cost tracking for Anthropic, OpenAI, Qwen and DeepSeek: SQLite usage ledger, spend queries, provider comparison and CNY to USD conversion.
entries.zh: 本地跟踪 Anthropic、OpenAI、Qwen 和 DeepSeek 的 LLM API 成本：SQLite 用量账本、支出查询、服务商比较及人民币兑美元换算。

entries.english: VMware Aria Operations monitoring for vSphere: performance metrics, alarms, capacity analysis and anomaly detection, with audit logging for write actions.
entries.zh: 面向 vSphere 的 VMware Aria Operations 监控：性能指标、告警、容量分析和异常检测，对写入操作记录审计日志。

entries.english: Live .NET runtime diagnostics: find memory leaks, GC pressure, LOH fragmentation and thread starvation in any running .NET process without code changes.
entries.zh: 实时 .NET 运行时诊断：无需修改代码，即可在运行中的 .NET 进程中查找内存泄漏、GC 压力、LOH 碎片和线程饥饿。

entries.english: Ask what went wrong with your own Ollama calls: lost prompt cache and the token where the prompt stopped matching, context overflow, a model running partly on CPU, tool schemas crowding the prompt. Last turn in numbers; which local models fit in video memory. Read-only.
entries.zh: 排查自己的 Ollama 调用问题：提示词缓存失效及开始不匹配的 token、上下文溢出、模型部分运行在 CPU、工具 schema 占满提示词。提供上一轮数值和能装入显存的本地模型信息。只读。

entries.english: Control Adobe After Effects: run ExtendScript, render in the background and inspect comps and layers, with Arabic/RTL and multilingual support.
entries.zh: 控制 Adobe After Effects：运行 ExtendScript、后台渲染并检查合成与图层，支持阿拉伯语／从右到左及多语言。

entries.english: Suno AI music generation, lyrics, covers and vocal extraction via the Ace Data Cloud API.
entries.zh: 通过 Ace Data Cloud API 使用 Suno AI 生成音乐、歌词、翻唱并提取人声。

entries.english: Music, image, video and audio generation across Suno, Grok Imagine, Seedance, Kling, Veo, Ideogram and more: generate, edit, upscale, reframe and master.
entries.zh: 跨 Suno、Grok Imagine、Seedance、Kling、Veo、Ideogram 等生成音乐、图片、视频和音频：生成、编辑、放大、调整画幅及母带处理。

entries.english: Bacon Services MCP — MCP client for AI agents to discover and purchase creative services from Bacon Services using x402 payments, with local wallet signing and configurable spending limits.
entries.zh: Bacon Services MCP：供 AI 智能体发现并通过 x402 付款购买 Bacon Services 创意服务的 MCP 客户端，支持本地钱包签名和可配置支出限额。

entries.english: Search Pexels stock images and videos.
entries.zh: 搜索 Pexels 素材图片和视频。

entries.english: Generate presentation PDFs, narrated videos and MP3 audio from Markdown.
entries.zh: 从 Markdown 生成演示 PDF、带旁白的视频及 MP3 音频。

entries.english: Omnimodal AIGC framework that turns ComfyUI workflows into MCP tools without code, for text, image, sound and video generation, with a Chainlit web interface.
entries.zh: 全模态 AIGC 框架：无需编写代码即可将 ComfyUI 工作流变成 MCP 工具，用于文本、图片、声音和视频生成，并提供 Chainlit 网页界面。

entries.english: Local music video toolkit using ffmpeg: BPM, key and Camelot detection, best 15/30 s clip, beat-synced shot lists, Spotify Canvas maker and platform specs.
entries.zh: 使用 ffmpeg 的本地音乐视频工具箱：BPM、调性及 Camelot 检测，最佳 15／30 秒片段、节拍同步分镜表、Spotify Canvas 制作和平台规格。

entries.english: Create GIFs from videos.
entries.zh: 从视频创建 GIF。

entries.english: Generate and render Manim-Slides presentations: run Manim code headlessly, compile to Reveal.js HTML, PDF or PPTX, and preview slides as images, videos or GIFs.
entries.zh: 生成并渲染 Manim-Slides 演示文稿：无界面运行 Manim 代码、编译为 Reveal.js HTML、PDF 或 PPTX，并将幻灯片预览为图片、视频或 GIF。

entries.english: Generate video and images on Dare (Seedance 2.5 and 2.0, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0 Pro, Hailuo 2.3, Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2, Seedream 5 Pro) from Claude, billed to your own Dare credits, with local cost estimates and dry runs.
entries.zh: 从 Claude 通过 Dare 生成视频和图片（Seedance 2.5 和 2.0、Veo 3.1、Kling 3.0 Pro、Hailuo 2.3、Nano Banana 2、GPT Image 2、Seedream 5 Pro），使用你自己的 Dare 额度计费，支持本地成本估算和试运行。

entries.english: Local-first AI media workbench with a canvas, short-form timeline editor and shared assets, controllable by agents.
entries.zh: 本地优先的 AI 媒体工作台，包含画布、短视频时间线编辑器和共享素材，可由智能体控制。

entries.english: Video caption and B-roll generation via the ZapCap API.
entries.zh: 通过 ZapCap API 生成视频字幕和 B-roll 素材。

entries.english: Convert raster images (PNG, JPG, WebP, TIFF) to SVG from base64 or URL input, locally or via Docker.
entries.zh: 将栅格图片（PNG、JPG、WebP、TIFF）从 base64 或 URL 输入转换为 SVG，支持本地或 Docker 运行。

entries.english: Turn raw clips into a finished cut through chat.
entries.zh: 通过聊天将原始片段剪成成片。

entries.english: Check media file loudness against EBU R128 and ATSC A/85: pass/fail verdicts with per-metric deltas, spec citations and ffmpeg remediation commands.
entries.zh: 按 EBU R128 和 ATSC A/85 检查媒体文件响度：给出通过／失败判定、各指标差值、规范引用和 ffmpeg 修复命令。

entries.english: Image optimization and conversion, SVG QR codes, Cleanor Labs storage and image-format data, and dev utilities such as hashes, UUIDs, JWT decoding and regex.
entries.zh: 图片优化与转换、SVG 二维码、Cleanor Labs 存储及图片格式数据，以及哈希、UUID、JWT 解码和正则等开发工具。

entries.english: Compose motion-graphics videos from a single JSON document: author, validate and preview frames, add captions and promo templates, and render MP4s on GPU.
entries.zh: 从单个 JSON 文档合成动态图形视频：编写、验证和预览帧，添加字幕与宣传模板，并在 GPU 上渲染 MP4。

entries.english: Parse, edit and generate Final Cut Pro FCPXML timelines: health checks, flash frame detection, chapter markers, rough cuts and NLE export.
entries.zh: 解析、编辑和生成 Final Cut Pro FCPXML 时间线：健康检查、闪帧检测、章节标记、粗剪和非线性编辑器导出。

entries.english: Provider-neutral short-form AI video toolkit: dry-run payload validation and optional live generation via Sora, Veo, xAI and Seedance-style providers.
entries.zh: 与服务商无关的短视频 AI 工具箱：试运行载荷验证，并可选通过 Sora、Veo、xAI 和 Seedance 类服务商实际生成。

entries.english: Audio mastering with LUFS and true peak targets for Spotify and podcasts, Suno/Udio AI-fingerprint removal and a mastering passport in chat.
entries.zh: 音频母带处理：按 Spotify 和播客的 LUFS 与真峰值目标处理，移除 Suno/Udio AI 指纹，并在聊天中提供母带处理记录。

entries.english: Manage a self-hosted Immich photo library: CLIP natural language search, GPS album curation, duplicate detection, library health reports and HTML galleries.
entries.zh: 管理自托管 Immich 照片库：CLIP 自然语言搜索、按 GPS 策划相册、重复项检测、图库健康报告及 HTML 图库。

entries.english: Natural-language interface for Adobe Photoshop that plans edits and executes them with native Photoshop tools rather than generative AI.
entries.zh: Adobe Photoshop 自然语言接口：规划编辑并使用 Photoshop 原生工具执行，而非使用生成式 AI。

entries.english: Convert documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX), images, HTML and Markdown to PDF via the FileToPDF API, returned as an embedded resource or saved to disk.
entries.zh: 通过 FileToPDF API 将文档（DOCX、XLSX、PPTX）、图片、HTML 和 Markdown 转为 PDF，作为嵌入资源返回或保存到磁盘。

entries.english: Free, open-source screen recorder and video editor that agents drive over stdio (the desktop app's own executable started with `mcp`): record the screen, trim, zoom, caption, annotate and export demo videos, and add custom WGSL shader effects that export exactly as previewed.
entries.zh: 免费开源的屏幕录制和视频编辑器，智能体通过 stdio 驱动（以 `mcp` 启动桌面应用自身可执行文件）：录屏、裁剪、缩放、加字幕和标注、导出演示视频，并添加导出效果与预览一致的自定义 WGSL 着色器效果。

entries.english: Self-hosted AI studio exposing local image, video and music-video generation, upscaling, RAG and code intelligence, with renders queued on your own GPU.
entries.zh: 自托管 AI 工作室：提供本地图片、视频和音乐视频生成、放大、RAG 和代码智能，渲染任务在自己的 GPU 上排队。

entries.english: Search YouTube video transcripts and frames (slides, charts, on-screen text) and get matching moments with timestamped links and verified citations.
entries.zh: 搜索 YouTube 视频转录和画面（幻灯片、图表、屏幕文字），返回带时间戳链接和经过验证引用的匹配时刻。

entries.english: Local video understanding: word-timestamped transcripts, speaker labels, scenes, chapters and moment search from any video URL or file.
entries.zh: 本地视频理解：从任意视频 URL 或文件生成带词级时间戳的转录、说话人标签、场景、章节和片段搜索。

entries.english: Turn public YouTube, Twitch, Kick or TikTok video links into timestamped transcripts, chapters and clip suggestions.
entries.zh: 将公开的 YouTube、Twitch、Kick 或 TikTok 视频链接转成带时间戳的转录、章节和剪辑建议。

entries.english: Podcast editing service: submit raw audio or a URL and get edited episodes with filler words and noise removed, transcripts, show notes and social clips.
entries.zh: 播客编辑服务：提交原始音频或 URL，获取去除口头填充词和噪声的编辑后节目、转录、节目说明及社交片段。

entries.english: AI media generation (Flux, Veo, Suno) with cost controls: upfront price quotes, budget enforcement and reserve-burn-refund billing.
entries.zh: 带成本控制的 AI 媒体生成（Flux、Veo、Suno）：提前报价、预算执行和预留／消耗／退款计费。

entries.english: Drive Google Flow with your Google account: Veo text-to-video, image-to-video and clip extension, Imagen text-to-image, reusable characters and scenes.
entries.zh: 使用 Google 账户驱动 Google Flow：Veo 文生视频、图生视频及片段延长，Imagen 文生图，以及可复用角色和场景。

entries.english: Search, view and tag a local video library cataloged by Fast Video Cataloger: transcripts, scene thumbnails, visual search, keywords and bins.
entries.zh: 搜索、查看并标记由 Fast Video Cataloger 编目的本地视频库：转录、场景缩略图、视觉搜索、关键词和素材箱。

entries.english: Offline, deterministic audio engine: compose scores as data, render WAV or FLAC, report loudness, pitch, tempo and key, generate spectrograms and diff renders.
entries.zh: 离线、确定性的音频引擎：以数据形式创作乐谱、渲染 WAV 或 FLAC、报告响度／音高／速度／调性，生成频谱图并比较渲染结果。

entries.english: Turn YouTube videos into short-form clips via the Crabcut API: highlight detection, subtitles, 9:16 reframing and direct download URLs.
entries.zh: 通过 Crabcut API 将 YouTube 视频转为短片：亮点检测、字幕、9:16 画幅调整及直接下载 URL。

entries.english: Browser video editor driven through a JSON timeline: clips, keyframes, transitions, text animations, filters, reference-video analysis and ffmpeg export.
entries.zh: 通过 JSON 时间线驱动的浏览器视频编辑器：片段、关键帧、转场、文字动画、滤镜、参考视频分析和 ffmpeg 导出。

entries.english: Unified API for AI models across providers: browse models and prices, create image, video, music and audio tasks, poll results and call LLM endpoints.
entries.zh: 跨服务商 AI 模型统一 API：浏览模型和价格、创建图片／视频／音乐／音频任务、轮询结果并调用 LLM 端点。

entries.english: Tile large images and web page captures (via Chrome CDP) so vision models see full resolution, with model-specific token estimates and HTML tile previews.
entries.zh: 将大图和网页截图（通过 Chrome CDP）切成图块，让视觉模型看到完整分辨率，并提供按模型的 token 估算与 HTML 图块预览。

entries.english: Turn screen recordings or other local video and audio into local Whisper transcripts, keyframes, OCR and full-text search, with wall-clock timestamps for logs.
entries.zh: 将屏幕录制或其他本地视频、音频转为本地 Whisper 转录、关键帧、OCR 和全文搜索，并为日志提供实际时钟时间戳。

entries.english: Image generation and editing plus Veo, Sora and Seedance video generation via OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible APIs, with resumable video jobs.
entries.zh: 通过 OpenRouter 或兼容 OpenAI 的 API 生成和编辑图片，并通过 Veo、Sora 和 Seedance 生成视频；支持可恢复的视频任务。

entries.english: Score AI image and video generation prompts for models like Veo 3, Sora, Kling, Midjourney and Flux, and rewrite weak ones before generating.
entries.zh: 为 Veo 3、Sora、Kling、Midjourney 和 Flux 等模型的 AI 图片及视频生成提示词评分，在生成前改写较弱的提示词。

entries.english: Gaudio audio AI API: stem separation (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano), dialogue/music/effects separation and AI lyrics sync.
entries.zh: Gaudio 音频 AI API：分离音轨（人声、鼓、贝斯、吉他、钢琴）、分离对白／音乐／效果，以及 AI 歌词同步。

entries.english: Deterministic, non-generative image editing via declarative recipes: crop, mask, layer, apply LUTs, strip EXIF/GPS and encode, saved as immutable revisions.
entries.zh: 通过声明式配方进行确定性、非生成式图片编辑：裁剪、蒙版、图层、应用 LUT、移除 EXIF/GPS 并编码，保存为不可变修订。

entries.english: Read-only access to Clipy screen recordings: search the library, fetch timestamped transcripts, AI summaries and key moments with video frames.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Clipy 屏幕录制：搜索素材库、获取带时间戳的转录、AI 摘要，以及带视频帧的关键时刻。

entries.english: Video transcoding (MP4, WebM, ProRes, GIF, MP3) and document conversion (PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, XLSX) without AWS or FFmpeg setup.
entries.zh: 视频转码（MP4、WebM、ProRes、GIF、MP3）和文档转换（PDF、DOCX、HTML、Markdown、XLSX），无需配置 AWS 或 FFmpeg。

entries.english: Generate app icons, favicons, OG images, logos and wordmarks across many image models, validating contrast, text accuracy and palette before returning.
entries.zh: 通过多种图片模型生成应用图标、favicon、OG 图片、标志和字标，返回前验证对比度、文字准确性和配色。

entries.english: Gemini media generation: Nano Banana images and editing, Veo video, text-to-speech and Lyria music, via the Gemini API or Vertex AI.
entries.zh: Gemini 媒体生成：通过 Gemini API 或 Vertex AI 使用 Nano Banana 生成和编辑图片、Veo 生成视频、文本转语音及 Lyria 音乐。

entries.english: Video analysis: extract transcripts, key frames, OCR text and annotated timelines from Loom links and direct MP4 or WebM files.
entries.zh: 视频分析：从 Loom 链接及直接 MP4 或 WebM 文件提取转录、关键帧、OCR 文本和带注释的时间线。

entries.english: Render videos from JSON via the iLoveVideoEditor cloud API: motion-design templates, GPU effects, transitions, batch rendering and webhooks.
entries.zh: 通过 iLoveVideoEditor 云 API 从 JSON 渲染视频：动态图形模板、GPU 效果、转场、批量渲染和 webhook。

entries.english: Local, guardrailed video editing: FFmpeg edits, captions, audio, effects, Hyperframes, repurposing, resumable workflows, quality gates and provenance receipts.
entries.zh: 受防护约束的本地视频编辑：FFmpeg 编辑、字幕、音频、效果、Hyperframes、内容再利用、可恢复工作流、质量门槛和来源记录。

entries.english: AI 3D model generation via Tripo (text, image or multiview to 3D) plus retopology, format conversion (GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, USDZ) and stylization.
entries.zh: 通过 Tripo 生成 AI 3D 模型（文本、图片或多视图转 3D），并支持重拓扑、格式转换（GLB、FBX、OBJ、STL、USDZ）和风格化。

entries.english: Generate video from prompts, images or reference images across AI video models (Sora, Veo, Kling, Seedance and more), with cost quotes before spending.
entries.zh: 通过多个 AI 视频模型（Sora、Veo、Kling、Seedance 等）从提示词、图片或参考图生成视频，并在支出前提供成本报价。

entries.english: Turn long videos into vertical shorts: moment detection, face-tracked 9:16 reframing, captions, dubbing and publishing to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.
entries.zh: 将长视频变为竖屏短片：片段检测、人脸跟踪 9:16 画幅调整、字幕、配音，并发布到 TikTok、Instagram 和 YouTube。

entries.english: Full Replicate catalog for any MCP client: image, video, music and speech generation, voice cloning, 3D, upscaling, plus batch/DAG pipelines and fine-tuning.
entries.zh: 向任意 MCP 客户端提供完整 Replicate 模型目录：图片、视频、音乐和语音生成、声音克隆、3D、放大，以及批量／DAG 流水线和微调。

entries.english: Read-only SHAR Production metadata gate that validates rights-aware video-production manifests and returns a releasability result.
entries.zh: 只读 SHAR Production 元数据检查：验证考虑权利信息的视频制作清单，返回是否可以发布的结果。

entries.english: Official SpicyAPI server: browse 200+ image, video, audio and chat models (Seedance, Kling, Wan, MiniMax, Suno), get exact USD quotes, upload local files, create generation tasks and collect results, with a confirmation before every paid step.
entries.zh: 官方 SpicyAPI 服务器：浏览 200 多种图片、视频、音频和聊天模型（Seedance、Kling、Wan、MiniMax、Suno），获取精确美元报价、上传本地文件、创建生成任务并获取结果；每个付费步骤前均需确认。

entries.english: Multimodal access to OpenRouter models: text chat, image, audio and video analysis, and image, audio and video generation (Veo, Sora, Seedance, Wan).
entries.zh: 多模态访问 OpenRouter 模型：文本聊天、图片／音频／视频分析，以及图片／音频／视频生成（Veo、Sora、Seedance、Wan）。

entries.english: Examine image metadata such as EXIF, XMP, JFIF and GPS for searching and analyzing photo libraries.
entries.zh: 检查 EXIF、XMP、JFIF 和 GPS 等图片元数据，用于搜索和分析照片库。

entries.english: Media generation, editing and asset downloads with OpenAI Images/Videos and Google GenAI (Veo).
entries.zh: 使用 OpenAI Images/Videos 和 Google GenAI（Veo）生成、编辑媒体并下载素材。

entries.english: Computer vision-based image recognition and editing tools.
entries.zh: 基于计算机视觉的图像识别和编辑工具。

entries.english: Turn a storyboard JSON into a narrated, captioned product-demo MP4 (TTS voiceover, Whisper captions, auto-zoom) via Chrome replay and ffmpeg.
entries.zh: 通过 Chrome 回放和 ffmpeg 将分镜 JSON 转成带旁白及字幕的产品演示 MP4（TTS 配音、Whisper 字幕、自动缩放）。

entries.english: Sonos control via UPnP: device discovery, multi-room playback, queues, music library browsing, alarms, event subscriptions and EQ settings.
entries.zh: 通过 UPnP 控制 Sonos：设备发现、多房间播放、队列、音乐库浏览、闹钟、事件订阅及均衡器设置。

entries.english: Transcripts from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and podcasts, plus YouTube search and channel and playlist listing.
entries.zh: 获取 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram 和播客的转录，并支持 YouTube 搜索及列出频道和播放列表。

entries.english: Media processing via Transloadit Robots: video encoding (HLS, H.264, VP9), image resizing and watermarks, document conversion, OCR and transcription.
entries.zh: 通过 Transloadit Robots 处理媒体：视频编码（HLS、H.264、VP9）、图片缩放和水印、文档转换、OCR 及转录。

entries.english: Search and discover movies and TV shows with torrent links, quality scoring, streaming availability and cast/crew metadata.
entries.zh: 搜索和发现电影与电视剧，提供种子链接、质量评分、流媒体可用性及演职员元数据。

entries.english: Control Adobe Premiere Pro via the Scout panel: frame-accurate transcript search, markers, cuts, effects, transitions, exports and project management.
entries.zh: 通过 Scout 面板控制 Adobe Premiere Pro：帧精度转录搜索、标记、剪切、效果、转场、导出和项目管理。

entries.english: Local-first video editor: cut by transcript, attach b-roll to phrases, score, caption, render and master, then verify the render against the edit.
entries.zh: 本地优先的视频编辑器：根据转录剪切、将 B-roll 附加到语句、配乐、加字幕、渲染和母带处理，再根据编辑内容验证渲染结果。

entries.english: Local video search, trimming, stitching and playback through conversation, using the ffmpeg command line.
entries.zh: 通过对话使用 ffmpeg 命令行，在本地搜索、裁剪、拼接和播放视频。

entries.english: Video and audio editing: trim, merge, effects, overlays, format conversion, audio processing and YouTube downloads, chaining steps without intermediate files.
entries.zh: 视频与音频编辑：裁剪、合并、效果、叠加、格式转换、音频处理和 YouTube 下载，无需中间文件即可串联步骤。

entries.english: AI image enhancement (upscaling, denoising, sharpening) via the Topaz Labs API, with models such as Standard V2, Wonder 2, Bloom and Recover 3.
entries.zh: 通过 Topaz Labs API 增强 AI 图片（放大、降噪、锐化），支持 Standard V2、Wonder 2、Bloom 和 Recover 3 等模型。

entries.english: AutoEQ headphone and IEM EQ data: search by name or sound signature, get parametric EQ settings, compare models band by band and browse Harman rankings.
entries.zh: AutoEQ 耳机和入耳式耳机均衡器数据：按名称或声音特征搜索、获取参数均衡设置、逐频段比较型号并浏览 Harman 排名。

entries.english: Submit media-processing jobs to the Rendobar API with local file upload: transcode, run raw FFmpeg, burn in captions and add watermarks.
entries.zh: 向 Rendobar API 提交媒体处理任务并上传本地文件：转码、运行原始 FFmpeg、烧录字幕及添加水印。

entries.english: Run image, video, audio and 3D models from the WaveSpeed catalog: model search, schema introspection, local file upload and price quotes before running.
entries.zh: 运行 WaveSpeed 目录中的图片、视频、音频和 3D 模型：支持模型搜索、schema 检查、本地文件上传和运行前报价。

entries.english: Drive the WeftCut desktop video editor: trim and split clips, keyframes, effects, captions, audio mixing, markers and export, with live edits and dry runs.
entries.zh: 驱动 WeftCut 桌面视频编辑器：裁剪和拆分片段、关键帧、效果、字幕、混音、标记和导出，支持实时编辑及试运行。

entries.english: Identify and remove AI watermarks and provenance metadata (Gemini and Veo marks, SynthID, C2PA, EXIF) in images and video you generated yourself, plus provenance metadata in audio. Runs as `uvx remove-ai-watermarks mcp`.
entries.zh: 识别并移除你自己生成的图片和视频中的 AI 水印与来源元数据（Gemini 和 Veo 标记、SynthID、C2PA、EXIF），以及音频中的来源元数据。运行方式为 `uvx remove-ai-watermarks mcp`。

entries.english: Offline OCR and image analysis via Apple's Vision framework: text from images and PDFs with bounding boxes, face, barcode and QR detection, and classification.
entries.zh: 通过 Apple Vision 框架离线 OCR 和图片分析：从图片及 PDF 提取带边界框的文字，检测人脸、条形码和二维码并进行分类。

entries.english: Detect AI-generated music (Suno, Udio) and media, with AI-probability verdicts, provenance signals (Content Credentials, SynthID) and folder scans.
entries.zh: 检测 AI 生成音乐（Suno、Udio）和媒体，提供 AI 生成概率判定、来源信号（Content Credentials、SynthID）及文件夹扫描。

entries.english: Music production in REAPER: transport, tracks, MIDI editing, mixing and FX, tempo maps, markers and regions, and ReaScript execution.
entries.zh: 在 REAPER 中制作音乐：播放控制、轨道、MIDI 编辑、混音与效果、节奏图、标记与区域以及 ReaScript 执行。

entries.english: Cut clips from YouTube videos via the AppsGolem API in a chosen format and quality, and get a direct download URL.
entries.zh: 通过 AppsGolem API 按所选格式和质量从 YouTube 视频剪辑片段，并获取直接下载 URL。

entries.english: Generate AI images, video, voiceovers, avatars and UGC ads with many models via Fattly.
entries.zh: 通过 Fattly 使用多种模型生成 AI 图片、视频、配音、数字人和 UGC 广告。

entries.english: Apple Music control on macOS: DJ daemon and energy mixes, multi-room AirPlay, Spotify and M3U playlist import, listening journal and Apple Replay analytics.
entries.zh: macOS 上的 Apple Music 控制：DJ 守护进程与能量混音、多房间 AirPlay、Spotify 和 M3U 播放列表导入、收听日志及 Apple Replay 分析。

entries.english: GNOME desktop automation via D-Bus: screenshots, window management, mouse and keyboard input, clipboard, workspaces and notifications on GNOME 45 to 49.
entries.zh: 通过 D-Bus 自动化 GNOME 桌面：在 GNOME 45 至 49 上进行截图、窗口管理、鼠标键盘输入、剪贴板、工作区和通知操作。

entries.english: Read-only desktop context through OpenWand: current selection, clipboard, active window, browser page and screen.
entries.zh: 通过 OpenWand 只读获取桌面上下文：当前选区、剪贴板、活动窗口、浏览器页面和屏幕。

entries.english: Hybrid computer-use runtime combining the accessibility tree, Chrome DevTools Protocol and vision into structured context, with offline support via Ollama.
entries.zh: 混合计算机操作运行时：将无障碍树、Chrome DevTools Protocol 和视觉合并为结构化上下文，并可通过 Ollama 离线使用。

entries.english: Windows desktop automation with entity-based actions instead of coordinate clicks, using UIA, CDP, screenshots, keyboard, mouse, clipboard and terminal control.
entries.zh: Windows 桌面自动化：以实体操作代替坐标点击，使用 UIA、CDP、截图、键盘、鼠标、剪贴板和终端控制。

entries.english: See and control your own Windows PC locally or remotely: UIA and screenshot observation, clicking, typing, dragging, scrolling, launching apps and Live View.
entries.zh: 在本地或远程查看和控制自己的 Windows 电脑：通过 UIA 和截图观察，支持点击、输入、拖动、滚动、启动应用及 Live View。

entries.english: Local macOS servers for Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Messages, Contacts, Notes, Shortcuts, Files, Maps and system tools, unified or standalone.
entries.zh: 本地 macOS 服务器，提供邮件、日历、提醒、信息、联系人、备忘录、快捷指令、文件、地图及系统工具，可统一或单独使用。

entries.english: A Linux system monitoring MCP server providing real-time CPU, memory, disk, network, processes, Docker, systemd, security audit, and hardware info via STDIO transport. Install: download from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Mohabdo21/linux-mcp/releases) or `go install github.com/Mohabdo21/linux-mcp@latest`.
entries.zh: 通过 STDIO 传输提供实时 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、进程、Docker、systemd、安全审计及硬件信息的 Linux 系统监控 MCP 服务器。安装方式：从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Mohabdo21/linux-mcp/releases) 下载或运行 `go install github.com/Mohabdo21/linux-mcp@latest`。

entries.english: Control Nemeton, a macOS virtual machine manager built on Apple's Virtualization framework: Linux and macOS VMs, APFS snapshots, console, files and networking.
entries.zh: 控制基于 Apple Virtualization 框架的 macOS 虚拟机管理器 Nemeton：Linux 和 macOS 虚拟机、APFS 快照、控制台、文件及网络。

entries.english: Physical USB HID keyboard and mouse control via a Raspberry Pi Pico 2: move, click, drag, type, key combos and scroll, with a mock mode for testing.
entries.zh: 通过 Raspberry Pi Pico 2 控制实体 USB HID 键盘和鼠标：移动、点击、拖动、输入、组合键和滚动，提供用于测试的模拟模式。

entries.english: Screen OCR on macOS via FreezeText: freeze the screen and extract text with Apple Vision, OCR regions or images, and search capture history.
entries.zh: 通过 FreezeText 在 macOS 上进行屏幕 OCR：冻结屏幕并用 Apple Vision 提取文字，对区域或图片进行 OCR，以及搜索捕获历史。

entries.english: Inspect, debug and drive running WPF apps without source changes: visual tree, dependency properties, bindings, DataContext, screenshots, clicks and text input.
entries.zh: 无需修改源码即可检查、调试和驱动运行中的 WPF 应用：视觉树、依赖属性、绑定、DataContext、截图、点击和文字输入。

entries.english: Drive native GUI apps under development: launch, screenshot, read the accessibility tree, inject input, tail logs and diff frames on desktop, Android and iOS.
entries.zh: 驱动开发中的原生 GUI 应用：在桌面、Android 和 iOS 上启动、截图、读取无障碍树、注入输入、跟踪日志并比较画面。

entries.english: Mac window manager and menu bar utilities: arrange windows across displays, snap to custom zones, save workspaces, window screenshots and on-device OCR.
entries.zh: Mac 窗口管理器和菜单栏工具：跨显示器排列窗口、贴靠到自定义区域、保存工作区、截取窗口及设备端 OCR。

entries.english: Drive an iPhone or iOS Simulator via XCUIAutomation and WebDriverAgent, with compact screen digests and confirmation before destructive actions.
entries.zh: 通过 XCUIAutomation 和 WebDriverAgent 驱动 iPhone 或 iOS 模拟器，提供精简屏幕摘要，并在破坏性操作前确认。

entries.english: Turn a Mac into a remote computer-use server via CUA: screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows and apps, token-protected and exposed through a Cloudflare tunnel.
entries.zh: 通过 CUA 将 Mac 变成远程计算机操作服务器：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口和应用，通过 token 保护并经 Cloudflare 隧道暴露。

entries.english: Full Mac control: shell, AppleScript, files, processes and human-like GUI input with a screenshot loop, plus an optional safe mode with read-only, gated access.
entries.zh: 完整 Mac 控制：shell、AppleScript、文件、进程及通过截图循环模拟人类的 GUI 输入，并提供可选的只读、受控安全模式。

entries.english: Read-only-by-default Mac control: files, processes, screenshots and clipboard, with opt-in allowlisted shell commands, AppleScript and GUI input.
entries.zh: 默认只读的 Mac 控制：文件、进程、截图和剪贴板；可主动启用允许列表中的 shell 命令、AppleScript 和 GUI 输入。

entries.english: Fork, break and revert VirtualBox VMs with linked clones and RAM snapshots, and drive GUI-only guests via screenshots and input without SSH or a guest agent.
entries.zh: 通过链接克隆和内存快照分叉、破坏并恢复 VirtualBox 虚拟机；通过截图和输入驱动仅有 GUI 的来宾系统，无需 SSH 或来宾代理。

entries.english: Accessibility-first computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux: element IDs instead of pixels, background input, a pointer overlay and its own Chrome tab group.
entries.zh: macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上以无障碍为优先的计算机操作：使用元素 ID 而非像素、后台输入、指针叠层及独立 Chrome 标签组。

entries.english: Computer-use for Kasm Workspaces: lets AI agents see and drive your self-hosted Kasm desktops (screenshots, clicks, typing) over KasmVNC, with stock workspace images.
entries.zh: 面向 Kasm Workspaces 的计算机操作：让 AI 智能体通过 KasmVNC 查看并驱动自托管 Kasm 桌面（截图、点击、输入），使用标准工作区镜像。

entries.english: Run Apple Shortcuts on an iPhone, iPad or Mac (even locked), send lock-screen notifications and receive device events over an end-to-end encrypted relay.
entries.zh: 在 iPhone、iPad 或 Mac 上运行 Apple 快捷指令（即使设备锁定），通过端到端加密中继发送锁屏通知并接收设备事件。

entries.english: Desktop control for any AI agent on Windows, macOS and Linux. Reads the screen as text (accessibility tree, then OCR) and acts on controls by name, with screenshots only as a last resort, so a task costs a fraction of the tokens of a screenshot loop. 7 compound tools, one safety gate, verifies its own actions, and pauses for the user at sign-ins. Local-only, any tool-calling model.
entries.zh: 供任意 AI 智能体使用的 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 桌面控制：以文本读取屏幕（先无障碍树、再 OCR），按名称操作控件，仅在最后手段使用截图，项目称比截图循环节省大量 token。提供 7 个复合工具、一个安全关卡、操作验证，并在登录时暂停等待用户。仅本地运行，支持任意可调用工具的模型。

entries.english: Read-only Apple Podcasts analytics for shows you own via Podcasts Connect Reporter: plays, unique and engaged listeners, followers and per-episode listening.
entries.zh: 通过 Podcasts Connect Reporter 只读分析你拥有的 Apple Podcasts 节目：播放次数、独立和活跃听众、关注者及各单集收听情况。

entries.english: Read-only podcast analytics from OP3 (Open Podcast Prefix Project): downloads over time, listener geography, app share and per-episode breakdowns.
entries.zh: 从 OP3（Open Podcast Prefix Project）只读获取播客分析：下载量趋势、听众地区、应用份额和单集细分。

entries.english: Search the Podcast Index: podcasts, episodes, guest appearances by person, trending shows and feed health.
entries.zh: 搜索 Podcast Index：播客、单集、按人物查找嘉宾出场、热门节目及订阅源健康情况。

entries.english: Browse an Audiobookshelf library, query listening history and stats, and sync progress, bookmarks, collections and playlists, with optional read-only mode.
entries.zh: 浏览 Audiobookshelf 图书馆、查询收听历史与统计、同步进度、书签、合集和播放列表，提供可选只读模式。

entries.english: Software estimation: PERT, COCOMO II, Monte Carlo, sprint forecasting, token-to-time and cost mapping, and schedule-risk analysis.
entries.zh: 软件估算：PERT、COCOMO II、蒙特卡洛、迭代预测、token 到时间和成本的映射，以及进度风险分析。

entries.english: Stateless Redmine integration with per-request credentials: list, create and update issues, full-text search across issues and comments, and edit journals.
entries.zh: 无状态 Redmine 集成，每次请求携带凭据：列出、创建和更新问题，跨问题与评论全文搜索，并编辑日志记录。

entries.english: Search, read, create and update Redmine issues, projects and time entries, including journals, attachments, comments and time tracking.
entries.zh: 搜索、读取、创建和更新 Redmine 问题、项目和工时记录，包括日志、附件、评论和工时跟踪。

entries.english: Polarion ALM: documents as Markdown, Lucene or SQL search, traceability link traversal, and work item and comment management with dry-run writes.
entries.zh: Polarion ALM：将文档作为 Markdown 使用，通过 Lucene 或 SQL 搜索，遍历可追溯链接，管理工作项与评论，支持写入试运行。

entries.english: Combine Help Scout tickets and ProductLift feature requests into prioritized product plans, scoring themes by cross-source convergence and scrubbing PII.
entries.zh: 将 Help Scout 工单和 ProductLift 功能请求组合成排序后的产品计划，根据跨来源一致性为主题评分并清除个人身份信息。

entries.english: Framedeck Kanban content production for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and podcast creators: productions, stages, cards, checklists, comments and labels.
entries.zh: 面向 YouTube、Instagram、TikTok 和播客创作者的 Framedeck 看板内容制作：作品、阶段、卡片、清单、评论和标签。

entries.english: Full Procore REST API access for construction project management via discovery and execution tools: projects, RFIs, submittals, daily logs, budgets and more.
entries.zh: 通过发现和执行工具完整访问 Procore REST API，用于建筑项目管理：项目、信息请求、报审材料、日记、预算等。

entries.english: Jira-like SQLite project tracker: projects, epics, tasks and subtasks, dependencies with auto-blocking, threaded comments, templates and activity logs.
entries.zh: 类似 Jira 的 SQLite 项目跟踪器：项目、史诗、任务和子任务、自动阻塞的依赖、线程式评论、模板和活动日志。

entries.english: Trello integration: boards, cards, lists, labels, checklists, attachments (including images), members, custom fields and search, with a read-only mode.
entries.zh: Trello 集成：看板、卡片、列表、标签、清单、附件（包括图片）、成员、自定义字段和搜索，提供只读模式。

entries.english: Taiga project management: issues, user stories, tasks, epics, sprints, comments, attachments and wiki via a compact set of tools.
entries.zh: Taiga 项目管理：通过精简工具集管理问题、用户故事、任务、史诗、迭代、评论、附件和 wiki。

entries.english: Review a plan for what's missing: unstated assumptions, omitted technical risks and execution blind spots, as a structured pre-mortem.
entries.zh: 审查计划缺失的内容：未陈述假设、遗漏的技术风险及执行盲点，并形成结构化事前复盘。

entries.english: Product management: link customer feedback to features, releases and objectives, with roadmap-drift detection and funnel, retention, NPS and NRR analytics.
entries.zh: 产品管理：将客户反馈关联到功能、版本和目标，检测路线图偏离，并分析漏斗、留存、NPS 和 NRR。

entries.english: Turn Loupe visual feedback into a backlog: list pinned comments, read each with its element's HTML, computed styles and screenshot, and update its status.
entries.zh: 将 Loupe 可视化反馈转为待办：列出置顶评论，读取每条评论及其元素 HTML、计算样式和截图，并更新状态。

entries.english: Operate the Kelvia task manager: boards, tasks, sprints, member roles, worklogs and a time-blocking day planner.
entries.zh: 操作 Kelvia 任务管理器：看板、任务、迭代、成员角色、工作日志和时间分块日程规划器。

entries.english: Backlog, docs, history and memory as Markdown in the repository, versioned with the code, with card claims so parallel agents don't edit the same card.
entries.zh: 在仓库中以 Markdown 保存待办、文档、历史和记忆，随代码版本管理；支持卡片认领，避免并行智能体编辑同一张卡片。

entries.english: Redmine: issues, projects, wiki, attachments with text extraction, time entries, and release and blocker analytics; read-only by default, optional writes.
entries.zh: Redmine：问题、项目、wiki、带文本提取的附件、工时记录以及发布和阻塞分析；默认只读，可选写入。

entries.english: Zuuna developer project management: read and update boards, cards and comments, with cards moved automatically by git activity when PRs merge.
entries.zh: Zuuna 开发者项目管理：读取和更新看板、卡片和评论，PR 合并时根据 git 活动自动移动卡片。

entries.english: fenbs project board where people and AI assistants are members with roles: tasks, decisions with sign-off, testing notes and project rules, every change signed. Remote server at https://fenbs.ai/api/mcp or `npx -y fenbs-mcp`.
entries.zh: fenbs 项目看板：人和 AI 助手以带角色的成员身份参与；管理任务、需要签署的决策、测试记录和项目规则，所有更改均签名。远程服务器为 https://fenbs.ai/api/mcp，也可运行 `npx -y fenbs-mcp`。

entries.english: Work orchestration for AI coding agents: create, move and link issues, cut branches, open and merge PRs, and notify — on Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira, Linear and Slack — through one normalized contract, with each tracker's states mapped to roles once at `baron init` and committed. Install: `npx -y @zanaat/baron-mcp-server@latest`.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编码智能体的工作编排：通过统一契约在 Azure DevOps、GitHub、Jira、Linear 和 Slack 上创建、移动及关联问题，创建分支，打开和合并 PR 并发送通知；各跟踪器状态在 `baron init` 时一次性映射为角色并提交。安装：`npx -y @zanaat/baron-mcp-server@latest`。

entries.english: Redfin for-sale, for-rent and sold listings with full filters, plus complete property pages, as JSON.
entries.zh: 以 JSON 提供 Redfin 待售、待租和已售房源，支持完整筛选和完整房产页面。

entries.english: Zillow for-sale, for-rent and sold listings with filters, and full property details (price and tax history, schools, agent), as JSON.
entries.zh: 以 JSON 提供 Zillow 待售、待租和已售房源及筛选，包含价格与税务历史、学校和经纪人等完整房产详情。

entries.english: Propstack real estate CRM: search contacts, manage properties, track deals and schedule viewings.
entries.zh: Propstack 房地产 CRM：搜索联系人、管理房产、跟踪交易并安排看房。

entries.english: California property tax appeals: check Proposition 8 decline-in-value eligibility from comparable sales and prepare the county's review form.
entries.zh: 加州房产税申诉：根据可比成交检查 Proposition 8 价值下降资格，并准备县级复核表。

entries.english: UK planning application data via PlanWire: search by council, postcode, keyword, status, type or date, find applications near a location and fetch details.
entries.zh: 通过 PlanWire 获取英国规划申请数据：按议会、邮编、关键词、状态、类型或日期搜索，查找某位置附近申请并获取详情。

entries.english: US real estate debt: commercial loan maturities, HUD contract expiries and LIHTC compliance endings, plus Massachusetts and New York parcels and sales.
entries.zh: 美国房地产债务数据：商业贷款到期、HUD 合同到期及 LIHTC 合规期结束，以及马萨诸塞州和纽约州地块与成交数据。

entries.english: Commercial disruption data via the Forgemesh API: WARN layoff notices, company context, geospatial territory disruption and x402 payment challenge checks.
entries.zh: 通过 Forgemesh API 获取商业中断数据：WARN 裁员通知、公司背景、地理区域中断和 x402 支付挑战检查。

entries.english: Cook County and Chicago property records by address or PIN: parcels, sales, building permits, tax assessments and comparables, paid per call via x402.
entries.zh: 按地址或 PIN 查询库克县和芝加哥房产记录：地块、成交、建筑许可、税务评估和可比房产，通过 x402 按次付费。

entries.english: Multifamily real estate deal analysis for 2 to 200 unit properties: cap rate, DSCR, cash-on-cash, IRR, deal score, maximum offer price and market data.
entries.zh: 面向 2 至 200 套单元多户住宅的交易分析：资本化率、DSCR、现金回报率、IRR、交易评分、最高报价和市场数据。

entries.english: AI real estate photo and video editing via the Pedra API: virtual staging, renovation, room emptying, enhancement, sky replacement and property videos.
entries.zh: 通过 Pedra API 进行 AI 房地产照片及视频编辑：虚拟布置、翻新、清空房间、增强、替换天空和房产视频。

entries.english: Read-only SF Peninsula building permit and parcel buildability data: permit search, SB 9 lot-split eligibility, ADU feasibility and redevelopment leads.
entries.zh: 只读访问旧金山半岛建筑许可和地块可建性数据：许可搜索、SB 9 地块拆分资格、ADU 可行性及再开发线索。

entries.english: Guest check-in and SES.HOSPEDAJES police registration for Spanish short-term rentals: bookings, guest-form completion, SES filing status and check-in links.
entries.zh: 西班牙短租旅客入住与 SES.HOSPEDAJES 警方登记：预订、旅客表单完成情况、SES 提交状态和入住链接。

entries.english: US county parcel data: owner-name, APN and address lookup across 479 counties (494 verified ArcGIS REST endpoints, all 50 states plus DC), plus city code-violation, building-permit and zoning-case datasets. No API key.
entries.zh: 美国县级地块数据：覆盖 479 个县的业主姓名、APN 和地址查询（494 个已验证 ArcGIS REST 端点，覆盖全部 50 州及华盛顿特区），另有城市规范违规、建筑许可和分区案件数据集。无需 API 密钥。

entries.english: Italian cadastral, geospatial and real estate data: address geocoding, parcel profiles (risk, solar potential, valuations, POIs) and parcel lookup.
entries.zh: 意大利地籍、地理空间和房地产数据：地址地理编码、地块概况（风险、太阳能潜力、估值、兴趣点）及地块查询。

entries.english: Polish Central Statistical Office (GUS) Local Data Bank (BDL): browse subjects, search variables and territorial units (voivodeship, powiat, gmina), get unit details, and fetch a variable's time series over a year range. No API key; queries bdl.stat.gov.pl directly with no third-party middleman.
entries.zh: 波兰中央统计局（GUS）地方数据库（BDL）：浏览主题，搜索变量和行政区域单位（省、县、乡），获取单位详情，以及按年份范围获取变量时间序列。无需 API 密钥；直接查询 bdl.stat.gov.pl，不经过第三方中介。

entries.english: Google Trends data as JSON: interest over time and by region, plus rising and top related queries and topics for any keyword.
entries.zh: 以 JSON 提供 Google Trends 数据：任意关键词随时间和地区的热度，以及上升和热门相关查询与主题。

entries.english: Google Scholar search as JSON with author and year filters, cited-by and all-versions lookups, and formatted citations with BibTeX export.
entries.zh: 以 JSON 提供 Google Scholar 搜索，支持作者和年份筛选、被引与全部版本查询，以及格式化引用和 BibTeX 导出。

entries.english: Register LLMs and agents and submit Markdown research papers to the BenchClaw leaderboard, where a panel of judges scores them with deception detectors.
entries.zh: 注册 LLM 和智能体，并将 Markdown 研究论文提交至 BenchClaw 排行榜，由评审小组结合欺骗检测器评分。

entries.english: Checks every reference of a LaTeX paper against Crossref, dblp, arXiv, DataCite, PubMed and OpenAlex records: whether each cited work exists, matches its metadata and was not retracted, with no LLM in the verdict.
entries.zh: 对照 Crossref、dblp、arXiv、DataCite、PubMed 和 OpenAlex 记录检查 LaTeX 论文的每条参考文献：被引作品是否存在、元数据是否匹配以及是否被撤稿；判定过程不使用 LLM。

entries.english: Hlido trust scores, claim audits and comparisons for reviewed AI agents: tier verdicts, per-claim pass/fail audits and signed evidence.
entries.zh: 针对已审查 AI 智能体提供 Hlido 信任评分、主张审计和比较：等级判定、逐条主张通过／失败审计和签名证据。

entries.english: Startup and product opportunities mined from Reddit, Hacker News, Product Hunt and Stack Exchange: pain points, trending themes and commercial scores.
entries.zh: 从 Reddit、Hacker News、Product Hunt 和 Stack Exchange 挖掘创业及产品机会：痛点、热门主题和商业评分。

entries.english: Read-only lookups of independent RealRun test results for AI models on everyday tasks (inbox triage, meeting scheduling, receipts): scores, model recommendations and safety warnings.
entries.zh: 只读查询 AI 模型在日常任务（收件箱分流、会议安排、收据）上的独立 RealRun 测试结果，提供评分、模型建议和安全警告。

entries.english: Self-hosted perception server: local bilingual ASR, vision, cross-lingual search, credentialed login-walled sources and a persistent relation graph.
entries.zh: 自托管感知服务器：本地双语 ASR、视觉、跨语言搜索、使用凭据访问登录限制的来源，以及持久关系图。

entries.english: Verified web research for AI agents (formerly BrowseAI Dev). Real-time search with cited claims, confidence scores, live citation-health checks, and signed evidence records. MCP server, REST API, and Python SDK.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的经核验网页研究工具（原 BrowseAI Dev）：实时搜索、带引用的主张、置信度评分、实时引用健康检查和签名证据记录。提供 MCP 服务器、REST API 和 Python SDK。

entries.english: Cluefinch MCP provides Deep Research infrastructure for AI agents: web search, incremental page reading, source-link navigation, and multi-source evidence collection while the agent remains in control of planning and reasoning.
entries.zh: Cluefinch MCP 为 AI 智能体提供深度研究基础设施：网页搜索、增量页面阅读、来源链接导航和多来源证据收集，同时由智能体掌控规划与推理。

entries.english: Read-only search of declassified U.S. federal UAP/UFO records, with hotspots, timelines, a live map dataset and direct source links.
entries.zh: 只读搜索已解密的美国联邦 UAP/UFO 记录，提供热点、时间线、实时地图数据集和直接来源链接。

entries.english: Search, cite and compare the Pāli Canon (Tipiṭaka): hybrid search, full suttas with cross-references, aligned translations and Pāli dictionary lookup.
entries.zh: 搜索、引用和比较巴利文三藏：混合搜索、带交叉引用的完整经文、对齐译文及巴利文字典查询。

entries.english: Read and write a local Zotero library via its local API, offline: collections, items, attachments, full text, BibTeX and CSL export, tags and saved searches.
entries.zh: 通过本地 API 离线读写 Zotero 文库：合集、条目、附件、全文、BibTeX 和 CSL 导出、标签及已保存搜索。

entries.english: Search and cite rare historical texts (alchemy, Hermeticism, Renaissance philosophy) from Source Library with DOI-backed citations.
entries.zh: 搜索并引用 Source Library 中的稀有历史文本（炼金术、赫尔墨斯主义、文艺复兴哲学），提供由 DOI 支持的引用。

entries.english: Ask paid human workers questions via GetABrain and get schema-validated JSON answers: yes/no, ratings, rankings, A/B tests, sentiment, media review and capture.
entries.zh: 通过 GetABrain 向付费人工工作者提问，获取符合 schema 验证的 JSON 答案：是／否、评分、排序、A/B 测试、情感、媒体审阅与采集。

entries.english: Create, validate, run, inspect and verify AgentFEM finite-element simulations.
entries.zh: 创建、验证、运行、检查并核实 AgentFEM 有限元模拟。

entries.english: Read and write a Zotero library: items, collections, tags, attachments, notes and bibliography export, with multi-tenant sign-in using your own Zotero API key.
entries.zh: 读写 Zotero 文库：条目、合集、标签、附件、笔记和参考文献导出，使用自己的 Zotero API 密钥进行多租户登录。

entries.english: French election results since 1999 at polling-station level, with INSEE data, elected officials and boundaries: maps, vote-reserve analysis and read-only SQL.
entries.zh: 1999 年以来法国投票站级选举结果，结合 INSEE 数据、当选官员和边界，提供地图、潜在票源分析及只读 SQL。

entries.english: Hourly LLM-ranked news briefings (AI, markets, sports, world) as structured JSON and e-ink pages, plus provenance data for every candidate story.
entries.zh: 每小时生成由 LLM 排序的新闻简报（AI、市场、体育、世界），以结构化 JSON 和电子墨水页面呈现，并为每条候选新闻提供来源信息。

entries.english: US immigration guidance: live Visa Bulletin, priority date checks and explanations of immigration terms.
entries.zh: 美国移民指导：实时 Visa Bulletin、优先日期检查和移民术语解释。

entries.english: Scientific visualization for CFD, FEA and SPH: render, slice, contour, volume-render and animate OpenFOAM, VTK and CGNS data headlessly.
entries.zh: 面向 CFD、FEA 和 SPH 的科学可视化：以无界面方式渲染、切片、绘制等值线和体渲染，并为 OpenFOAM、VTK 和 CGNS 数据制作动画。

entries.english: Federated academic search across OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, PubMed and more, with citation graphs, full-text reading, PDFs and a local paper library.
entries.zh: 跨 OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar、arXiv、PubMed 等进行联邦学术搜索，提供引用图谱、全文阅读、PDF 和本地论文库。

entries.english: Query classical Chinese texts from pre-Qin to Wei-Jin (Shiji, Zuozhuan, Analects and more) by event, person, place or virtue, with cited passages.
entries.zh: 按事件、人物、地点或德行查询先秦至魏晋古籍（史记、左传、论语等），返回引用原文。

entries.english: Send research papers to Kindle or Kobo: search arXiv and OpenAlex, find related work, queue papers in Zotero and deliver PDFs via email or Dropbox.
entries.zh: 将研究论文发送到 Kindle 或 Kobo：搜索 arXiv 和 OpenAlex、查找相关工作、在 Zotero 中排队，并通过邮件或 Dropbox 递送 PDF。

entries.english: Research methods library: recommends causal inference and econometric designs, returns runnable R and Python code, and cites the sources.
entries.zh: 研究方法库：推荐因果推断和计量经济学设计，返回可运行的 R 和 Python 代码并引用来源。

entries.english: Resolve scholarly identifiers (DOI, PMID, ISBN, arXiv and more) to CSL JSON, format citations in thousands of styles, or export to BibTeX, RIS or EndNote.
entries.zh: 将学术标识符（DOI、PMID、ISBN、arXiv 等）解析为 CSL JSON，以数千种样式格式化引用，或导出为 BibTeX、RIS 或 EndNote。

entries.english: Check for existing competition before building: scan GitHub, Hacker News, npm, PyPI and Product Hunt for similar projects, duplicate likelihood and pivot hints.
entries.zh: 构建前检查是否已有竞争项目：扫描 GitHub、Hacker News、npm、PyPI 和 Product Hunt，查找类似项目、重复可能性和转向建议。

entries.english: Search and fetch research datasets across Zenodo, DataCite, NCBI and PubMed/OpenAIRE, with DOI deduplication, paper-to-data linking and verified downloads.
entries.zh: 跨 Zenodo、DataCite、NCBI 和 PubMed/OpenAIRE 搜索并获取研究数据集，支持 DOI 去重、论文与数据关联及验证下载。

entries.english: Evidence-grounded web research: verify claims on pages with citations, confidence bands and policy reports, and synthesize multi-page sessions.
entries.zh: 基于证据的网页研究：用引用、置信区间和政策报告核验页面主张，并综合多个页面的研究会话。

entries.english: 18 read-only tools over the abliteration.org catalog: every abliterated and uncensored LLM on Hugging Face, their method classification, download trends, deletion history, and four alignment indices.
entries.zh: 针对 abliteration.org 目录的 18 个只读工具：查看 Hugging Face 上经 abliteration 处理及未审查的 LLM、方法分类、下载趋势、删除历史和四项对齐指标。

entries.english: Freedom-of-information requests in Germany via FragDenStaat: find the responsible authority, check the law and deadline, track requests and draft new ones.
entries.zh: 通过 FragDenStaat 提出德国信息公开请求：寻找主管机构、核查法律与期限、跟踪请求并起草新请求。

entries.english: Zotero integration with preview-first, journaled writes: reads via the local Zotero desktop API without a key, writes via the Web API.
entries.zh: Zotero 集成，写入前先预览并记录日志：通过本地 Zotero 桌面 API 无密钥读取，通过 Web API 写入。

entries.english: Zotero integration: hybrid search, PDF passages with page locators, CSL bibliographies, add by DOI, group libraries and writes including PDF annotations.
entries.zh: Zotero 集成：混合搜索、带页码定位的 PDF 片段、CSL 参考文献、通过 DOI 添加、群组文库及包含 PDF 标注的写入。

entries.english: Query Original Voices digital twins, each representing a real person, to understand what users think and why.
entries.zh: 查询 Original Voices 数字孪生体（每个代表一位真实人物），了解用户的想法及原因。

entries.english: Natural-language patent and scientific literature search via Patsnap: semantic and BM25 search, structured filters and record retrieval.
entries.zh: 通过 Patsnap 使用自然语言搜索专利和科学文献：语义与 BM25 搜索、结构化筛选及记录获取。

entries.english: Patent search and prior art discovery using the Google Patents public dataset on BigQuery: patent details with CPC codes and citations, and claims text.
entries.zh: 使用 BigQuery 上的 Google Patents 公开数据集搜索专利和发现现有技术：提供含 CPC 代码及引用的专利详情和权利要求文本。

entries.english: Deep research via the OpenAI Responses API or Open Deep Research (smolagents), with web search and code interpreter support.
entries.zh: 通过 OpenAI Responses API 或 Open Deep Research（smolagents）进行深度研究，支持网页搜索和代码解释器。

entries.english: Search a database of startup gaps by industry, role or keyword, each with the pain point, solution direction and a blueprint link. Works offline.
entries.zh: 按行业、角色或关键词搜索创业缺口数据库，每项包含痛点、解决方向和蓝图链接。可离线使用。

entries.english: Self-hosted YouTube research: video and channel search, transcripts, comments, playlists, timestamped frames and private local semantic corpora.
entries.zh: 自托管 YouTube 研究：视频与频道搜索、转录、评论、播放列表、带时间戳的画面和私有本地语义语料库。

entries.english: Patent prior art search and startup IP analysis: clone risk scores, defensibility maps, patentable features and competitor patent landscapes.
entries.zh: 专利现有技术搜索和创业公司知识产权分析：克隆风险评分、可防御性地图、可申请专利的功能和竞争对手专利格局。

entries.english: Eight local research workflow tools for task setup, saved progress, stage guidance, configurable report review, and delivery checks.
entries.zh: 八个本地研究工作流工具，用于任务设置、保存进度、阶段指导、可配置报告审查和交付检查。

entries.english: Gramps Web genealogy: search and edit family tree records, explore ancestors, descendants, relationships and timelines, and read media with privacy-aware previews. Includes a read-only mode and Claude Desktop bundles.
entries.zh: Gramps Web 家谱：搜索和编辑家谱记录，探索祖先、后代、关系及时间线，并通过考虑隐私的预览读取媒体。包含只读模式和 Claude Desktop 安装包。

entries.english: Autonomous multi-source deep research with DuckDuckGo search (zero API keys), parallel scrapers, markdown cleaning, synthesis with citations, fact-checking, and persistent memory.
entries.zh: 自主多来源深度研究：DuckDuckGo 搜索（无需 API 密钥）、并行抓取、Markdown 清洗、带引用综合、事实核查和持久记忆。

entries.english: Legislative data from all 50 US states and Congress via the LegiScan API: search bills, get full text, track votes and look up legislators.
entries.zh: 通过 LegiScan API 获取美国 50 个州和国会的立法数据：搜索法案、获取全文、跟踪投票并查询议员。

entries.english: UNESCO Institute for Statistics indicators on education, science, culture and communication by country, region and year, with provenance on every response.
entries.zh: 联合国教科文组织统计研究所的教育、科学、文化与传播指标，按国家、地区和年份查询，每个响应均提供来源信息。

entries.english: Semantic Scholar academic papers: search, paper and author retrieval, citation-graph traversal and recommendations.
entries.zh: Semantic Scholar 学术论文：搜索、获取论文和作者信息、遍历引用图谱并获取推荐。

entries.english: Full-text search of the Library of Congress's digitised American newspapers, plus catalogue search by media type and curated collections.
entries.zh: 对美国国会图书馆数字化美国报纸进行全文搜索，并按媒体类型和精选合集搜索目录。

entries.english: Search the open catalogue of the Bibliothèque nationale de France for authors, their works and the editions held.
entries.zh: 搜索法国国家图书馆开放目录中的作者、作品和馆藏版本。

entries.english: Full-text search inside the Internet Archive's scanned books, periodicals and documents, catalogue search, and Wayback Machine captures of a URL by date.
entries.zh: 对互联网档案馆扫描的书籍、期刊和文档进行全文搜索、目录搜索，并按日期查询 URL 在 Wayback Machine 中的存档。

entries.english: Search Anna's Archive for books and journal articles by title, author, topic or DOI, and download the chosen file.
entries.zh: 按标题、作者、主题或 DOI 在 Anna’s Archive 搜索书籍和期刊文章，并下载选定文件。

entries.english: Run AI-led qualitative research interviews and surveys with Agent Interviews: create interviewers, manage projects, recruit participants and analyze results.
entries.zh: 通过 Agent Interviews 开展 AI 主导的定性研究访谈和调查：创建访谈者、管理项目、招募参与者并分析结果。

entries.english: Auditable strategic-risk memos (sanctions, regulation, geopolitics, trade) with Central Asia and Gulf regional specialists and per-claim evidence; no live data.
entries.zh: 提供可审计的战略风险备忘录（制裁、监管、地缘政治、贸易），结合中亚及海湾地区专家和逐项主张证据；不含实时数据。

entries.english: Check citations against Crossref for retractions, corrections or expressions of concern before they go into a paper, summary or review.
entries.zh: 在引用进入论文、摘要或评论之前，使用 Crossref 检查撤稿、更正和关注声明。

entries.english: Research workspace for Zotero, Obsidian and NotebookLM: search arXiv, Semantic Scholar, PubMed and Crossref, ingest into Zotero, sync notes and verify briefs.
entries.zh: 面向 Zotero、Obsidian 和 NotebookLM 的研究工作区：搜索 arXiv、Semantic Scholar、PubMed 和 Crossref，导入 Zotero、同步笔记并验证简报。

entries.english: Philippine government data: PHIVOLCS earthquakes and volcano alerts, PAGASA weather and typhoons, PhilGEPS procurement, PSA census data and AQICN air quality.
entries.zh: 菲律宾政府数据：PHIVOLCS 地震与火山警报、PAGASA 天气和台风、PhilGEPS 采购、PSA 人口普查及 AQICN 空气质量。

entries.english: Semantic search over CS and AI papers with citation-graph traversal, full-text extraction, embeddings and BibTeX export.
entries.zh: 对计算机科学和 AI 论文进行语义搜索，支持引用图谱遍历、全文提取、嵌入和 BibTeX 导出。

entries.english: ITASCA PFC discrete element simulation: browse documentation, execute scripts, capture plots and manage long-running tasks via a bridge to the PFC GUI.
entries.zh: ITASCA PFC 离散元模拟：通过连接 PFC GUI 的桥接器浏览文档、执行脚本、捕获图表并管理长时间任务。

entries.english: Ask SPARKIT, a scientific research agent, questions and get cited Markdown reports based on literature search and paper reading.
entries.zh: 向科学研究智能体 SPARKIT 提问，获得基于文献搜索和论文阅读、带引用的 Markdown 报告。

entries.english: YADE discrete element method (DEM) simulation: search API docs, run code via a REPL or background tasks, monitor progress and review task history.
entries.zh: YADE 离散元法（DEM）模拟：搜索 API 文档，通过 REPL 或后台任务运行代码，监控进度并查看任务历史。

entries.english: Science AI Journal tools: paper-tier prediction, AI peer review, research gap finder, journal recommender, duplicate publication checker and article writer.
entries.zh: Science AI Journal 工具：论文等级预测、AI 同行评审、研究空白查找、期刊推荐、重复发表检查及文章写作。

entries.english: Chemistry tools from NIST data: molar mass with uncertainties, isotope-distribution mass spectra and name-formula lookup, offline or with online fallback.
entries.zh: 基于 NIST 数据的化学工具：带不确定度的摩尔质量、同位素分布质谱和名称／化学式查询，支持离线或在线回退。

entries.english: Research open-source AI projects: search a live radar, compare and shortlist projects, and plan stacks, keeping facts, recommendations and risks separate.
entries.zh: 研究开源 AI 项目：搜索实时项目雷达、比较和筛选项目、规划技术栈，并分别记录事实、建议与风险。

entries.english: Local searchable index of PDFs, EPUBs and Word documents for grounded answers with page and section citations.
entries.zh: 本地可搜索的 PDF、EPUB 和 Word 文档索引，用于生成带页码和章节引用、有依据的回答。

entries.english: Add RAG-based AI chat to any website: local vector store, OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini models, a self-contained chat server and an embeddable widget.
entries.zh: 为任意网站添加基于 RAG 的 AI 聊天：本地向量存储、OpenAI／Anthropic／Gemini 模型、独立聊天服务器和可嵌入组件。

entries.english: Academic paper knowledge base over local PDFs: MinerU parsing, metadata normalization, Qdrant vector search with reranking and paginated full-text reading.
entries.zh: 基于本地 PDF 的学术论文知识库：MinerU 解析、元数据规范化、带重排的 Qdrant 向量搜索及分页全文阅读。

entries.english: Access the CustomGPT.ai RAG-as-a-service API.
entries.zh: 访问 CustomGPT.ai 的 RAG 即服务 API。

entries.english: Access Vectara's RAG-as-a-service platform.
entries.zh: 访问 Vectara 的 RAG 即服务平台。

entries.english: Rule-based decisions: a Rete engine returns verdicts explained via retrieval over your policy documents, with rules drafted from policy text and saved as YAML.
entries.zh: 基于规则的决策：Rete 引擎通过检索策略文档解释判定，规则从策略文本起草并保存为 YAML。

entries.english: Romanian company data: 4.2M ONRC firms, ANAF status and financial statements 2008–2025; lead lists by CAEN and county, list matching and due-diligence checks.
entries.zh: 罗马尼亚公司数据：420 万家 ONRC 企业、ANAF 状态和 2008–2025 年财务报表；按 CAEN 和县生成线索列表，支持名单匹配与尽职调查。

entries.english: Google Custom Search JSON API: web and image search through a Programmable Search Engine.
entries.zh: Google Custom Search JSON API：通过 Programmable Search Engine 搜索网页和图片。

entries.english: AI SEO audits: score AI crawler readiness, validate JSON-LD and robots.txt, compare human and crawler views, and generate llms.txt, robots.txt and JSON-LD.
entries.zh: AI SEO 审计：评估 AI 爬虫准备情况，验证 JSON-LD 和 robots.txt，比较人类与爬虫视图，并生成 llms.txt、robots.txt 和 JSON-LD。

entries.english: Bing search results as JSON: organic results, ads and the Copilot answer, targeted by market, country, language and device.
entries.zh: 以 JSON 提供 Bing 搜索结果：自然搜索结果、广告和 Copilot 回答，可按市场、国家、语言及设备定向。

entries.english: Remote MCP server for Google Images: image results with source pages, thumbnails and full-resolution URLs, filtered by size, colour and type, as JSON.
entries.zh: 面向 Google 图片的远程 MCP 服务器：以 JSON 返回图片结果、来源页面、缩略图和全分辨率 URL，可按大小、颜色和类型筛选。

entries.english: Search the web, fetch URLs and map sites as clean Markdown, getting past anti-bot blocks.
entries.zh: 搜索网页、获取 URL 并将网站映射为干净 Markdown，可处理反机器人阻挡。

entries.english: Web scraping: fetch public pages with optional JavaScript rendering, wait conditions and CSS or AI extraction rules, as Markdown, text, HTML or JSON.
entries.zh: 网页抓取：获取公开页面，可选 JavaScript 渲染、等待条件以及 CSS 或 AI 提取规则，输出 Markdown、文本、HTML 或 JSON。

entries.english: Stdio MCP proxy for public company jobs, hiring signals, technology detection and Google Ads research, with a shared free daily allowance and optional x402 payments.
entries.zh: STDIO MCP 代理，用于公开公司职位、招聘信号、技术检测和 Google Ads 研究，提供共享的每日免费额度和可选 x402 付费。

entries.english: Send a prompt to ChatGPT anonymously and read the answer as markdown together with every web source it consulted, as JSON. No OpenAI account or key.
entries.zh: 匿名向 ChatGPT 发送提示词，并以 JSON 读取 Markdown 答案及其查阅的全部网页来源。无需 OpenAI 账户或密钥。

entries.english: Read any public web page as clean Markdown, page metadata, or a page plus 4 same-site pages; pay per call in USDC via x402, no API key.
entries.zh: 将任意公开网页读取为干净 Markdown、页面元数据，或读取页面及同站点 4 个页面；通过 x402 以 USDC 按次付费，无需 API 密钥。

entries.english: Web page data: scrape to Markdown, extract metadata, links and JSON-LD, audit on-page SEO, detect tech stacks and validate XML sitemaps.
entries.zh: 网页数据：抓取为 Markdown、提取元数据／链接／JSON-LD、审计页面 SEO、检测技术栈并验证 XML 站点地图。

entries.english: Provider-neutral web search aggregating model grounding (Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and others) and search APIs such as Exa, Brave, Perplexity and Tavily.
entries.zh: 服务商中立的网页搜索，聚合模型接地结果（Gemini、Grok、DeepSeek 等）及 Exa、Brave、Perplexity 和 Tavily 等搜索 API。

entries.english: YouTube transcripts (text, JSON, SRT, VTT, srv3), video and channel search, playlists and large batch jobs.
entries.zh: YouTube 转录（文本、JSON、SRT、VTT、srv3）、视频和频道搜索、播放列表及大规模批量任务。

entries.english: Public data scrapers and lead extractors for Google Maps, Glassdoor, SEC EDGAR and state contractor registries.
entries.zh: 面向 Google Maps、Glassdoor、SEC EDGAR 和州承包商注册簿的公共数据抓取器及线索提取器。

entries.english: Software comparisons with prices sourced from each vendor's page (with URL and check date), plus ranked alternatives for any tool.
entries.zh: 软件比较：价格取自各供应商页面并附 URL 和检查日期，同时为任意工具提供排序后的替代方案。

entries.english: Recall-first web search that finds relevant events across the open web, beyond the top results.
entries.zh: 以召回率为先的网页搜索，在开放网络中查找不限于首批结果的相关事件。

entries.english: Convert web pages into clean Markdown locally, preserving tables, code blocks and headings.
entries.zh: 在本地将网页转为干净 Markdown，保留表格、代码块和标题。

entries.english: Pay-per-call x402 APIs (USDC on Base): LLM inference, GPU and CPU compute, on-chain, DeFi, SEC EDGAR and news data, and web scraping to Markdown.
entries.zh: 按次付费的 x402 API（Base 上的 USDC）：LLM 推理、GPU 和 CPU 计算、链上、DeFi、SEC EDGAR 和新闻数据，以及网页抓取为 Markdown。

entries.english: Local web search, fetching, crawling, extraction and research, with multi-engine search, local ML reranking, a SQLite cache and JavaScript rendering.
