entries.zh: 本地网页搜索、获取、爬取、提取和研究，支持多引擎搜索、本地机器学习重排、SQLite 缓存及 JavaScript 渲染。

entries.english: Real-time news with ML enrichment: urgency scoring, political lean and event clustering across many countries.
entries.zh: 带机器学习增强的实时新闻：覆盖多个国家的紧急程度评分、政治倾向和事件聚类。

entries.english: ICD-10-CM medical code lookup, validation and reverse search.
entries.zh: ICD-10-CM 医学代码查询、验证和反向搜索。

entries.english: Residential-proxy web access: scrape pages to Markdown, SERP search, site mapping and crawling, ready-made collectors, and proxy endpoints from your plans.
entries.zh: 住宅代理网页访问：将页面抓取为 Markdown、SERP 搜索、网站映射和爬取、现成采集器，以及你的套餐中的代理端点。

entries.english: Find where to stream movies and TV shows across Asian and Middle Eastern services such as Netflix, Disney+ Hotstar, Wavve, Shahid, ZEE5 and JioCinema.
entries.zh: 查找亚洲和中东流媒体服务上的电影与电视剧，例如 Netflix、Disney+ Hotstar、Wavve、Shahid、ZEE5 和 JioCinema。

entries.english: Curated audio news: search articles, fetch narrated audio, subscribe to topic feeds and surface stories matched to actively traded Kalshi event contracts.
entries.zh: 精选音频新闻：搜索文章、获取朗读音频、订阅主题信息流，并呈现与活跃交易的 Kalshi 事件合约匹配的新闻。

entries.english: Extract YouTube transcripts as clean text, with timestamps, or as structured JSON.
entries.zh: 将 YouTube 转录提取为干净文本、带时间戳文本或结构化 JSON。

entries.english: Live web grounding for local and cloud LLMs: web search, page fetch, token-capped cited evidence packs and an agentic search-and-read research loop.
entries.zh: 为本地和云端 LLM 提供实时网页接地：网页搜索、页面获取、受 token 限额约束且带引用的证据包，以及智能体搜索／阅读研究循环。

entries.english: Unified real-time search across Google, YouTube, Amazon, Walmart, Reddit and TikTok for web, e-commerce, product, social media and video data.
entries.zh: 跨 Google、YouTube、Amazon、Walmart、Reddit 和 TikTok 统一实时搜索网页、电商、商品、社交媒体和视频数据。

entries.english: Audit URLs for AI crawler readiness: checks robots.txt, llms.txt, JSON-LD schema and content density, with a 0-100 AEO score.
entries.zh: 审计 URL 是否便于 AI 爬虫访问：检查 robots.txt、llms.txt、JSON-LD schema 和内容密度，并给出 0–100 的 AEO 评分。

entries.english: Multi-engine web search across Bing, Baidu, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Exa and CSDN.
entries.zh: 跨 Bing、百度、DuckDuckGo、Brave、Exa 和 CSDN 的多引擎网页搜索。

entries.english: Google SERP search via the Ace Data Cloud API: web, image, news, maps, places, video and knowledge graph results.
entries.zh: 通过 Ace Data Cloud API 搜索 Google SERP：网页、图片、新闻、地图、地点、视频及知识图谱结果。

entries.english: AIFeed protocol tools: verify signed publisher manifests, fetch token-budgeted Markdown or MAKO pages, verify asset downloads and rank delta-index entries.
entries.zh: AIFeed 协议工具：验证签名发布者清单，获取受 token 预算约束的 Markdown 或 MAKO 页面，验证素材下载并排列增量索引条目。

entries.english: Crawl websites into clean Markdown, search pages and extract structured data with LLMs for web research and RAG pipelines.
entries.zh: 将网站抓取成干净 Markdown、搜索页面，并使用 LLM 提取结构化数据，供网页研究和 RAG 流水线使用。

entries.english: Real-time and historical news data, including top headlines from global sources, via AllNewsAPI.
entries.zh: 通过 AllNewsAPI 获取实时和历史新闻数据，包括全球来源的头条。

entries.english: Web search using Perplexity Sonar models, with source citations.
entries.zh: 使用 Perplexity Sonar 模型搜索网页并附来源引用。

entries.english: Hacker News: top stories by time window, category feeds, comment threads and full-text search via Algolia.
entries.zh: Hacker News：按时间窗口获取热门新闻、分类信息流、评论线程，并通过 Algolia 全文搜索。

entries.english: Web search (up to 5 results), URL-to-Markdown extraction and JavaScript page rendering for agents, paid per call ($0.005 in USDC on Base via x402 through the Pocket Agentic Portal) from a wallet key with a session spend cap; self-hosted AgentSearch API also supported.
entries.zh: 供智能体使用的网页搜索（最多 5 条结果）、URL 转 Markdown 提取和 JavaScript 页面渲染；通过 Pocket Agentic Portal 的 x402 从钱包密钥按次支付（Base 上 0.005 美元 USDC），支持会话支出上限；也支持自托管 AgentSearch API。

entries.english: Take screenshots of webpages to use as feedback during UI development.
entries.zh: 截取网页截图，作为 UI 开发过程中的反馈。

entries.english: Local-first web scraping, DuckDuckGo search, site mapping and crawling, using trafilatura with an optional Firecrawl fallback for JS-rendered pages.
entries.zh: 本地优先的网页抓取、DuckDuckGo 搜索、网站映射和爬取，使用 trafilatura，并可选 Firecrawl 作为 JavaScript 渲染页面的回退。

entries.english: Token-efficient local web crawler with Playwright-based stealth anti-bot bypass.
entries.zh: 高 token 效率的本地网页爬虫，使用基于 Playwright 的隐蔽反机器人绕过。

entries.english: Search Polish public tenders (BZP and TED): procuring entity and contractor profiles by NIP, market statistics by CPV or province, and a procurement glossary.
entries.zh: 搜索波兰公共招标（BZP 和 TED）：按 NIP 查询采购实体及承包商资料，按 CPV 或省份查询市场统计，并提供采购词汇表。

entries.english: Check which URLs Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Bing and Google AI Overviews cite for any query. Self-hosted.
entries.zh: 检查 Perplexity、Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Bing 和 Google AI Overviews 针对任意查询引用了哪些 URL。自托管。

entries.english: Multi-provider search broker with automatic fallback, RRF ranking, content extraction and budget enforcement.
entries.zh: 多服务商搜索代理，支持自动回退、RRF 排序、内容提取和预算执行。

entries.english: Web research on Apify: Brave and DuckDuckGo search, page fetching to clean Markdown, and multi-step research with relevance scoring and key fact extraction.
entries.zh: 在 Apify 上进行网页研究：Brave 和 DuckDuckGo 搜索、将页面获取为干净 Markdown，并通过相关性评分和关键事实提取进行多步研究。

entries.english: Local hybrid semantic and keyword search over PDF, DOCX, PPTX, Markdown and HTML documents, with file and page citations and a bundled embedding model.
entries.zh: 对 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、Markdown 和 HTML 文档进行本地语义与关键词混合搜索，提供文件和页码引用以及内置嵌入模型。

entries.english: Look up company ethics information: the ethical and unethical actions of major companies.
entries.zh: 查询公司伦理信息：大公司的符合伦理及不符合伦理的行为。

entries.english: Self-hosted SearXNG metasearch: web, image, news, video and music search plus SSRF-guarded page fetch with prompt-injection wrapping.
entries.zh: 自托管 SearXNG 元搜索：搜索网页、图片、新闻、视频和音乐，并提供带 SSRF 防护和提示注入包装的页面获取。

entries.english: Explore and interact with the Fediverse via ActivityPub: WebFinger discovery, timelines and instance exploration across Mastodon, Pleroma, Misskey and more.
entries.zh: 通过 ActivityPub 探索并与联邦宇宙交互：跨 Mastodon、Pleroma、Misskey 等进行 WebFinger 发现、时间线和实例探索。

entries.english: Browse Gopher and Gemini protocol resources, with TLS support and structured content extraction.
entries.zh: 浏览 Gopher 和 Gemini 协议资源，支持 TLS 和结构化内容提取。

entries.english: Read bot-walled pages as Markdown via an escalating unlocker, plus multi-provider web search with rank fusion, video transcripts and page asset grabbing.
entries.zh: 通过逐级解锁方式将机器人防护页面读取为 Markdown，并提供多服务商网页搜索与排名融合、视频转录和页面素材获取。

entries.english: Domain availability checks via real-time DNS and WHOIS lookups, with bulk checking, confidence scores and registration details.
entries.zh: 通过实时 DNS 和 WHOIS 查询检查域名可用性，支持批量检查、置信度评分和注册详情。

entries.english: Unsplash photo search, random photos and download tracking, with ready-to-use attribution text and HTML for each photo.
entries.zh: Unsplash 照片搜索、随机照片和下载跟踪，为每张照片提供可直接使用的署名文本和 HTML。

entries.english: Capture webpage screenshots, viewport or full-page, as base64 PNG.
entries.zh: 将网页视口或整页截图捕获为 base64 PNG。

entries.english: Deterministically convert web pages into decision-ready state: ISO dates, numbers with units as facts and token-budgeted chunks anchored to the page.
entries.zh: 以确定性方式将网页转为可用于决策的状态：提取 ISO 日期、带单位的数字事实及锚定页面、受 token 预算约束的文本块。

entries.english: Plans, prices, hidden costs, alternatives and comparisons for SaaS, AI and LLM tools.
entries.zh: SaaS、AI 和 LLM 工具的套餐、价格、隐藏成本、替代方案及比较。

entries.english: Real-time news with tone analysis, brand safety and narrative shift signals.
entries.zh: 实时新闻，提供语气分析、品牌安全和叙事变化信号。

entries.english: Evidence-backed business discovery and lead-list research: search by brief or criteria, inspect qualification evidence and exclusions, and export results.
entries.zh: 有证据支持的企业发现与潜在线索列表研究：按简介或条件搜索，检查资格证据与排除项，并导出结果。

entries.english: Remote MCP server for Indeed: job listings by keyword and location with salary, company and posting date, plus full job postings, as JSON.
entries.zh: 面向 Indeed 的远程 MCP 服务器：以 JSON 按关键词和地点获取职位列表（含薪资、公司和发布日期）及完整职位信息。

entries.english: Structured public web data as clean JSON across search, maps, commerce, social and finance.
entries.zh: 以干净 JSON 提供结构化公开网页数据，涵盖搜索、地图、电商、社交和金融。

entries.english: Kagi search and summarization without API access, authenticated with a Kagi session token.
entries.zh: 无需 API 访问即可使用 Kagi 搜索和摘要，通过 Kagi 会话令牌认证。

entries.english: Google Trends data: interest over time, interest by region, trending now, related queries and topic search.
entries.zh: Google Trends 数据：随时间及地区变化的热度、当前趋势、相关查询和主题搜索。

entries.english: Web search via your own SearXNG instance and/or You.com, plus page and site crawling to deduplicated Markdown with Crawl4AI and Playwright, including pages behind a login.
entries.zh: 通过自己的 SearXNG 实例和／或 You.com 搜索网页，并使用 Crawl4AI 和 Playwright 将页面及网站抓取为去重 Markdown，包括登录后的页面。

entries.english: Local search of foods, nutrition facts and barcodes in the OpenNutrition database.
entries.zh: 在 OpenNutrition 数据库中本地搜索食品、营养成分和条形码。

entries.english: Integration with the DealX platform.
entries.zh: 与 DealX 平台集成。

entries.english: Keyword and semantic search over curated AI applications in the HyperStore directory, with full app details and browsing.
entries.zh: 对 HyperStore 目录中精选 AI 应用进行关键词和语义搜索，提供完整应用详情与浏览。

entries.english: AI search, X search and web search for AI agents.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的 AI 搜索、X 搜索和网页搜索。

entries.english: Capability-routed search and web reading across GitHub, Crossref, Hacker News, Wikipedia and private SearXNG, plus URL-to-Markdown and health diagnostics.
entries.zh: 按能力路由的搜索与网页阅读，覆盖 GitHub、Crossref、Hacker News、Wikipedia 和私有 SearXNG，并提供 URL 转 Markdown 和健康诊断。

entries.english: Convert PDF, DOCX, HTML and URLs to clean, LLM-ready Markdown with tables preserved and boilerplate stripped.
entries.zh: 将 PDF、DOCX、HTML 和 URL 转成供 LLM 使用的干净 Markdown，保留表格并去除模板杂项。

entries.english: Domain availability and prices from Porkbun, Namecheap, GoDaddy, RDAP and WHOIS, with bulk search, registrar comparison, suggestions and social handle checks.
entries.zh: 从 Porkbun、Namecheap、GoDaddy、RDAP 和 WHOIS 获取域名可用性及价格，支持批量搜索、注册商比较、建议和社交账号名检查。

entries.english: Google Search Console and Indexing API: search analytics, sitemaps, URL inspection and batch indexing.
entries.zh: Google Search Console 和 Indexing API：搜索分析、站点地图、URL 检查和批量索引。

entries.english: Domain lifecycle management across Porkbun, Namecheap, GoDaddy and Cloudflare: availability, registration, DNS, SSL, email auth (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and WHOIS.
entries.zh: 跨 Porkbun、Namecheap、GoDaddy 和 Cloudflare 管理域名生命周期：可用性、注册、DNS、SSL、邮件认证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）和 WHOIS。

entries.english: Search and register Muumuu Domain (GMO Pepabo) domains, manage owned domains and contracts, and configure DNS records.
entries.zh: 搜索和注册 Muumuu Domain（GMO Pepabo）域名，管理已有域名和合同，并配置 DNS 记录。

entries.english: Dreamwork job search: browse live listings without a key, rank matches against your resume, generate tailored resumes and cover letters, apply and track applications.
entries.zh: Dreamwork 求职：无需密钥浏览实时职位、按简历对匹配项排序、生成定制简历及求职信、申请并跟踪申请。

entries.english: Collection of B2B sales intelligence servers: website analysis, tech stack detection, hiring signals, review aggregation, ad tracking and social profiles.
entries.zh: B2B 销售情报服务器集合：网站分析、技术栈检测、招聘信号、评论聚合、广告跟踪和社交资料。

entries.english: Play Melrōse music expressions as MIDI.
entries.zh: 将 Melrōse 音乐表达式作为 MIDI 播放。

entries.english: Deterministically decompose text into classified semantic units with authority, risk and attention scores plus entity extraction, without an LLM.
entries.zh: 无需 LLM，以确定性方式将文本拆分为分类语义单元，给出权威性、风险及注意力评分，并提取实体。

entries.english: Search JobDataLake's enriched job listings with filters for skills, salary, location, seniority, remote type and more.
entries.zh: 搜索 JobDataLake 增强职位信息，可按技能、薪资、地点、资历、远程类型等筛选。

entries.english: Live VR, AR and XR news, full-text VR.org originals, an events calendar, headset deals and comparisons.
entries.zh: 实时 VR、AR 和 XR 新闻、VR.org 原创全文、活动日历、头显优惠和比较。

entries.english: Verify scraped field values against the live source page, returning an Ed25519-signed pass, fail or unverifiable verdict that can be checked offline.
entries.zh: 对照实时来源页面验证抓取的字段值，返回可离线验证的 Ed25519 签名通过、失败或无法验证判定。

entries.english: Search Fiverr gigs, view seller profiles, compare gig packages and read reviews.
entries.zh: 搜索 Fiverr 服务、查看卖家资料、比较服务套餐并阅读评价。

entries.english: Transcribe YouTube videos to text using yt-dlp for audio and OpenAI Whisper for transcription, with chunked output for long videos.
entries.zh: 使用 yt-dlp 提取音频并用 OpenAI Whisper 转录，将 YouTube 视频转为文本；长视频支持分块输出。

entries.english: FoundRole job search: live ATS listings with salary benchmarks, H-1B sponsorship history and ghost-job grades, plus resume checks and an application tracker.
entries.zh: FoundRole 求职：实时 ATS 职位、薪资基准、H-1B 担保历史和幽灵职位评级，以及简历检查和申请跟踪。

entries.english: Web scraping that escalates from direct fetch to rotating proxy to full browser, solving anti-bot challenges and reporting which step worked and its cost.
entries.zh: 网页抓取逐级从直接获取升级到轮换代理和完整浏览器，处理反机器人挑战并报告成功步骤及其成本。

entries.english: Search recipes in the English Wikibooks Cookbook, read ingredients and steps, and rescale quantities.
entries.zh: 在英文 Wikibooks Cookbook 中搜索食谱、阅读食材和步骤，并按比例调整用量。

entries.english: Query Marmiton and the Wikibooks Cookbook together to compare recipes, and scale French and English ingredient lists, flagging what cannot be scaled.
entries.zh: 同时查询 Marmiton 和 Wikibooks Cookbook 比较食谱，按比例调整法语和英语食材清单，并标记无法缩放的项目。

entries.english: Generate vector embeddings for semantic search and RAG with Forge, Voxell's text-embedding API, including Matryoshka truncation.
entries.zh: 使用 Voxell 的文本嵌入 API Forge 为语义搜索和 RAG 生成向量嵌入，支持 Matryoshka 截断。

entries.english: Web search across DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google, Brave, Wikipedia, arXiv, YouTube and Reddit with deep page browsing. Instructs LLMs to search before answering.
entries.zh: 跨 DuckDuckGo、Bing、Google、Brave、Wikipedia、arXiv、YouTube 和 Reddit 搜索网页并深入浏览页面，指示 LLM 在回答前先搜索。

entries.english: Multi-agent research system for coding or general research tasks.
entries.zh: 面向编码或一般研究任务的多智能体研究系统。

entries.english: Semantic web search powered by SearXNG, paid per use in sats via Lightning Network micropayments. Self-hosted with phoenixd.
entries.zh: 由 SearXNG 驱动的语义网页搜索，通过闪电网络微支付按次以 sats 付费，使用 phoenixd 自托管。

entries.english: Search, rank and analyze GitHub developers for tech recruiting by location, role and skill, with AI scoring and contact discovery.
entries.zh: 面向技术招聘，按地点、角色和技能搜索、排序及分析 GitHub 开发者，提供 AI 评分和联系方式发现。

entries.english: Search and extract data from Chinese platforms including Taobao, JD, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, Weibo, Bilibili, Douban and Dianping, with local cookie storage.
entries.zh: 搜索并提取淘宝、京东、小红书、知乎、微博、Bilibili、豆瓣和大众点评等中国平台的数据，使用本地 cookie 存储。

entries.english: Search Rephonic podcast and episode data: listener estimates, demographics, contacts, transcripts, chart rankings, sponsors, reviews and audience overlap.
entries.zh: 搜索 Rephonic 播客与单集数据：听众估计、人口统计、联系方式、转录、榜单排名、赞助商、评论及受众重叠。

entries.english: Rewrite queries, zoom into source domains and return sourced answers with metrics.
entries.zh: 改写查询、深入来源域名，并返回带来源和指标的回答。

entries.english: Domain brainstorming via AgentDomainService: generate names from descriptions, score brandability and memorability, and check availability and prices.
entries.zh: 通过 AgentDomainService 构思域名：根据描述生成名称，为品牌适配性与易记性评分，并检查可用性和价格。

entries.english: Unsplash API: photos, search, users, collections, topics and stats, with guideline-compliant attribution, download tracking and rate-limit reporting.
entries.zh: Unsplash API：照片、搜索、用户、合集、主题和统计，提供符合指南的署名、下载跟踪及速率限制报告。

entries.english: Structured data APIs for Google Search, Maps, Trends and Flights, Amazon, Airbnb, Zillow, Yelp and more, returning clean JSON.
entries.zh: 提供 Google Search、Maps、Trends、Flights、Amazon、Airbnb、Zillow、Yelp 等的结构化数据 API，返回干净 JSON。

entries.english: Search papers via the Papers with Code API.
entries.zh: 通过 Papers with Code API 搜索论文。

entries.english: Web search across DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google (via SerpAPI) and Tavily with automatic rate limiting, caching and multi-language support.
entries.zh: 跨 DuckDuckGo、Bing、Google（通过 SerpAPI）和 Tavily 搜索网页，支持自动速率限制、缓存和多语言。

entries.english: Real-time access to remote job listings and company information from the Himalayas jobs database.
entries.zh: 实时访问 Himalayas 职位数据库中的远程职位及公司信息。

entries.english: Interact with Hacker News.
entries.zh: 与 Hacker News 交互。

entries.english: Check domain availability across many TLDs with DNS and WHOIS verification, bulk checking and name suggestions.
entries.zh: 通过 DNS 和 WHOIS 验证多个顶级域名的可用性，支持批量检查和名称建议。

entries.english: Aggregate RSS feeds.
entries.zh: 聚合 RSS 信息流。

entries.english: Fetch, filter, search and manage RSS feeds by category or source.
entries.zh: 按类别或来源获取、筛选、搜索和管理 RSS 信息流。

entries.english: WHOIS lookups via the IP2WHOIS API: domain registration details including expiry dates, registrar and registrant data.
entries.zh: 通过 IP2WHOIS API 查询 WHOIS：域名注册详情，包括到期日、注册商和注册人数据。

entries.english: Naver Search API integration: blog, news and shopping search plus DataLab analytics.
entries.zh: Naver Search API 集成：搜索博客、新闻和购物，以及 DataLab 分析。

entries.english: Google search with parallel queries for multiple keywords.
entries.zh: 通过并行查询多个关键词进行 Google 搜索。

entries.english: Search free stock photos on Pexels, Unsplash and Pixabay and download the chosen one into a local folder, with per-provider error reporting.
entries.zh: 在 Pexels、Unsplash 和 Pixabay 搜索免费素材照片，并将选中照片下载到本地文件夹，分别报告各服务商错误。

entries.english: Convert any URL into clean Markdown with structured metadata (title, byline, published date, language), paid per use via x402.
entries.zh: 将任意 URL 转为干净 Markdown，并附结构化元数据（标题、作者、发布日期、语言）；通过 x402 按次付费。

entries.english: Media discovery, requests and management via Overseerr and Seerr for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby.
entries.zh: 通过 Overseerr 和 Seerr 为 Plex、Jellyfin 和 Emby 发现、请求和管理媒体。

entries.english: Search and download royalty-free stock photos from Pexels and Unsplash, with rich metadata and pagination.
entries.zh: 从 Pexels 和 Unsplash 搜索并下载免版税素材照片，提供丰富元数据和分页。

entries.english: Domain name search that returns only .com domains verified as available via live Verisign RDAP checks.
entries.zh: 域名搜索：仅返回通过实时 Verisign RDAP 检查确认可用的 .com 域名。

entries.english: Convert websites to clean Markdown with links preserved, using Mozilla Readability, caching, robots.txt-aware crawling and concurrent fetching.
entries.zh: 使用 Mozilla Readability 将网站转为保留链接的干净 Markdown，支持缓存、遵循 robots.txt 的爬取及并发获取。

entries.english: Capture website screenshots, tiling full pages into 1072x1072 chunks for Claude Vision, with configurable viewports and wait strategies for dynamic content.
entries.zh: 捕获网站截图，将整页切为 1072×1072 图块供 Claude Vision 使用，并可配置视口和动态内容等待策略。

entries.english: Search the web with Kagi Search.
entries.zh: 使用 Kagi Search 搜索网页。

entries.english: Scrape, crawl and search the web, converting any URL to LLM-ready Markdown via real Chrome browsers.
entries.zh: 通过真实 Chrome 浏览器抓取、爬取和搜索网页，将任意 URL 转为适合 LLM 使用的 Markdown。

entries.english: Live web search and clean Markdown page fetching over the Keenable web index.
entries.zh: 基于 Keenable 网页索引进行实时网页搜索并获取干净 Markdown 页面。

entries.english: Chromium-free web content extraction in a single binary: fetch, render, crawl and screenshot pages with the Servo browser engine.
entries.zh: 单个二进制文件中无需 Chromium 的网页内容提取：使用 Servo 浏览器引擎获取、渲染、爬取和截取页面。

entries.english: Query and extract only the needed parts of JSON files to keep LLM context small.
entries.zh: 仅查询并提取 JSON 文件中需要的部分，以减少 LLM 上下文。

entries.english: Extract clean web content for RAG and answer questions about web pages.
entries.zh: 提取适用于 RAG 的干净网页内容，并回答有关网页的问题。

entries.english: Web search and page contents as LLM-ready Markdown, pruned to the passages relevant to the query, plus cited answers, research, crawl and site maps. Keyless free tier.
entries.zh: 以适合 LLM 使用的 Markdown 提供网页搜索和页面内容，裁剪至与查询相关的段落，并提供带引用的回答、研究、爬取和网站地图。免费层无需密钥。

entries.english: Web search using the Microsoft Bing Search API.
entries.zh: 使用 Microsoft Bing Search API 搜索网页。

entries.english: Search across DuckDuckGo, Sogou, Bing, Baidu, Wikipedia, Startpage, Yandex and Mojeek with waterfall search, multi-source verification and news search.
entries.zh: 跨 DuckDuckGo、搜狗、Bing、百度、Wikipedia、Startpage、Yandex 和 Mojeek 搜索，支持瀑布式搜索、多来源验证及新闻搜索。

entries.english: Real-time Korean web data via Apify: Naver place reviews and news, Melon music chart, Daangn and Bunjang listings and Musinsa fashion rankings.
entries.zh: 通过 Apify 获取实时韩国网页数据：Naver 地点评论和新闻、Melon 音乐榜单、Daangn 和 Bunjang 列表及 Musinsa 时尚排名。

entries.english: Extract content from web pages, PDFs, Word documents, YouTube transcripts, audio and video with automatic engine selection and structured JSON output.
entries.zh: 从网页、PDF、Word 文档、YouTube 转录、音频和视频提取内容，自动选择引擎并输出结构化 JSON。

entries.english: Index files, code and crawled websites and answer with source citations, using its own local models or an existing Ollama or LM Studio setup.
entries.zh: 索引文件、代码和已爬取网站，使用自己的本地模型或已有 Ollama／LM Studio 环境生成带来源引用的回答。

entries.english: Control LinkedIn accounts and retrieve real-time LinkedIn data.
entries.zh: 控制 LinkedIn 账户并获取实时 LinkedIn 数据。

entries.english: Parse PDFs, images, DOCX and PPTX via the MinerU document parsing API, with multilingual OCR, batch processing, page ranges and local file upload.
entries.zh: 通过 MinerU 文档解析 API 解析 PDF、图片、DOCX 和 PPTX，支持多语言 OCR、批处理、页码范围和本地文件上传。

entries.english: Google Search, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Google Maps, Google AI Mode, AI Overview and Shopping results as JSON.
entries.zh: 以 JSON 提供 Google Search、Bing、DuckDuckGo、Google Maps、Google AI Mode、AI Overview 和 Shopping 结果。

entries.english: Verified free HTTP, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 proxy lists from Litport, filtered by country, anonymity, latency and uptime. Returns records only; no API key needed.
entries.zh: 从 Litport 获取经验证的免费 HTTP、SOCKS4 和 SOCKS5 代理列表，可按国家、匿名性、延迟和可用性筛选。仅返回记录；无需 API 密钥。

entries.english: Discover, extract and interact with the web via Bright Data, one interface for automated access to the public internet.
entries.zh: 通过 Bright Data 发现、提取并与网页交互，为自动化访问公共互联网提供统一接口。

entries.english: Search TCGPlayer, Reverb and Thumbtack, verify US contractor and nurse licenses, and look up PSA card grading population data.
entries.zh: 搜索 TCGPlayer、Reverb 和 Thumbtack，验证美国承包商及护士执照，并查询 PSA 卡片评级数量数据。

entries.english: Detect whether a company only claims AI, deploys AI tooling on its site or charges for AI, returning an AI maturity tier with supporting evidence.
entries.zh: 检测公司是仅声称使用 AI、在网站部署 AI 工具还是对 AI 收费，返回 AI 成熟度等级及支持证据。

entries.english: Monitor company changes across hiring, tech stack, funding, firmographics, and social since the last run. Returns only deltas as typed change events.
entries.zh: 监控公司自上次运行以来在招聘、技术栈、融资、企业画像及社交方面的变化，仅以类型化变更事件返回增量。

entries.english: Find a company's contact page and extract role emails, a phone number and a postal address.
entries.zh: 查找公司的联系页面并提取角色邮箱、电话号码和邮寄地址。

entries.english: Builds a company list from a market definition: companies hiring for a role, or US SEC filers whose filings mention a phrase.
entries.zh: 根据市场定义建立公司名单：招聘某角色的公司，或申报文件中提及某短语的美国 SEC 申报公司。

entries.english: Enrich a company domain with firmographics: employee band, industry, HQ, founding year, revenue estimate, logo and description, with source provenance.
entries.zh: 为公司域名补充企业画像：员工规模区间、行业、总部、成立年份、收入估计、标志和描述，并附来源。

entries.english: Map a company domain to its LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube profiles and follower counts as flat Clay-ready JSON via an Apify actor.
entries.zh: 通过 Apify actor 将公司域名映射到 LinkedIn、X、Instagram、Facebook 和 YouTube 资料及粉丝数，输出可供 Clay 使用的扁平 JSON。

entries.english: Finds influencers by keyword or curated niche across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, Twitch, Threads, and podcasts, filtered by follower range.
entries.zh: 跨 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Pinterest、Twitch、Threads 和播客，按关键词或精选细分领域寻找影响者，并按粉丝数区间筛选。

entries.english: Resolve a company domain or name to its LinkedIn company URL, with confidence scoring and firmographic metadata.
entries.zh: 将公司域名或名称解析为其 LinkedIn 公司 URL，提供置信度评分和企业画像元数据。

entries.english: List the third-party conferences and trade shows a company publicly says it attends, with the year of each.
entries.zh: 列出公司公开表示参加的第三方会议及展会，并标明各自年份。

entries.english: Scan Google News and PR wires for a company's funding rounds, executive moves, launches and acquisitions as deduplicated, dated events in Clay-ready JSON.
entries.zh: 扫描 Google News 和新闻稿渠道中的公司融资、管理层变动、产品发布和收购，输出可供 Clay 使用、去重且带日期的事件 JSON。

entries.english: Resolve a company domain to its GitHub organization with repository, language and activity signals.
entries.zh: 将公司域名解析到其 GitHub 组织，并提供仓库、语言和活动信号。

entries.english: Detect GTM hiring signals on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby career pages, returning Clay-ready JSON with role counts, signal strength and ATS detection.
entries.zh: 从 Greenhouse、Lever 和 Ashby 招聘页面检测 GTM 招聘信号，返回可供 Clay 使用的 JSON，包含职位数量、信号强度和 ATS 检测。

entries.english: Detect CRM, sequencer and marketing automation tools from a company domain as boolean GTM tool signals for Clay enrichment.
entries.zh: 从公司域名检测 CRM、销售序列及营销自动化工具，作为供 Clay 信息补充使用的布尔 GTM 工具信号。

entries.english: Scan job boards on five ATS platforms for configurable role categories (GTM, engineering, finance, ops), returning keyword match counts and signal strength.
entries.zh: 扫描五个 ATS 平台的招聘信息，针对可配置岗位类别（GTM、工程、财务、运营）返回关键词匹配数和信号强度。

entries.english: Tracks whether CRM contacts left, moved, or were promoted, with current employer, title, start date, and the source and age behind each answer.
entries.zh: 跟踪 CRM 联系人是否离职、转岗或晋升，提供当前雇主、职位、开始日期，以及每条答案的来源和时效。

entries.english: Resolve a company domain to its Trustpilot rating, review count and claimed status.
entries.zh: 将公司域名解析为 Trustpilot 评分、评论数量及是否已认领状态。

entries.english: Returns the people a company publishes on its own team, leadership, or about page, with names, titles, and the source page.
entries.zh: 返回公司在其团队、领导层或关于页面上公开列出的人物，包括姓名、职位及来源页面。

entries.english: Search firsthand observations agents recorded about products, APIs, services or places, as opposed to documentation claims, and write back new ones.
entries.zh: 搜索智能体记录的有关产品、API、服务或地点的第一手观察，而非文档中的声明，并可写入新的观察。

entries.english: Read any URL as clean Markdown, get link metadata (Open Graph, favicon), take desktop/mobile screenshots and extract links and images, powered by the JsonLink API.
entries.zh: 通过 JsonLink API 将任意 URL 读取为干净 Markdown、获取链接元数据（Open Graph、favicon）、截取桌面／移动端截图并提取链接与图片。

entries.english: Web, image, news, video and local point-of-interest search using Brave's Search API.
entries.zh: 使用 Brave Search API 搜索网页、图片、新闻、视频及本地兴趣点。

entries.english: Fault-tolerant, stealth-enabled web search and content fetching.
entries.zh: 具备容错和隐蔽功能的网页搜索与内容获取。

entries.english: Fetch any URL as clean Markdown, with HTTP/3, JS rendering, anti-fingerprinting, browser cookie auth and 1Password integration.
entries.zh: 将任意 URL 获取为干净 Markdown，支持 HTTP/3、JavaScript 渲染、反指纹、浏览器 cookie 认证和 1Password 集成。

entries.english: Extract timestamped YouTube transcripts, plus video search, metadata and related videos.
entries.zh: 提取带时间戳的 YouTube 转录，并支持视频搜索、元数据和相关视频。

entries.english: Web content fetching and processing for AI consumption.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 消费的网页内容获取与处理。

entries.english: Semantic search of free-license stock photos from Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay and more by scene description, example image or similarity, with attribution.
entries.zh: 根据场景描述、示例图片或相似度，对 Unsplash、Pexels、Pixabay 等的自由许可素材照片进行语义搜索，并提供署名。

entries.english: Real-time world news: events clustered from many sources, classified by topic and geography and ranked by importance.
entries.zh: 实时世界新闻：聚合多个来源的事件，按主题和地区分类并按重要性排序。

entries.english: Discover, buy, verify and retrieve licensed expert analysis, with per-article license keys, on-chain proof and EU AI Act Article 53 attestation.
entries.zh: 发现、购买、验证和获取经许可的专家分析，提供逐篇文章许可密钥、链上证明及欧盟 AI 法案第 53 条声明。

entries.english: Web search via embedded SearXNG, content extraction and library docs indexing with hybrid FTS5 and semantic search using built-in Qwen3 embeddings.
entries.zh: 通过内嵌 SearXNG 搜索网页、提取内容并索引库文档，使用内置 Qwen3 嵌入进行 FTS5 与语义混合搜索。

entries.english: Read and manage a self-hosted FreshRSS instance: feeds, categories, labels, articles, read and star state, and OPML import and export.
entries.zh: 读取和管理自托管 FreshRSS 实例：信息流、分类、标签、文章、已读与星标状态，以及 OPML 导入导出。

entries.english: Primitive RAG-like web search that runs locally, without external APIs.
entries.zh: 在本地运行的基础类 RAG 网页搜索，无需外部 API。

entries.english: Manage cryptocurrency project documentation across Ethereum, BSC, Polygon and Solana.
entries.zh: 管理跨 Ethereum、BSC、Polygon 和 Solana 的加密货币项目文档。

entries.english: Deep research agent from Octagon.
entries.zh: Octagon 的深度研究智能体。

entries.english: Web intelligence: SERP analysis, competitor research, market trends, content gap analysis, keyword insights, audience discovery and citation tracking.
entries.zh: 网络情报：SERP 分析、竞品研究、市场趋势、内容缺口分析、关键词洞察、受众发现和引用跟踪。

entries.english: Convert PDFs, Word and PowerPoint files, images and spreadsheets to Markdown via the MinerU document parsing API.
entries.zh: 通过 MinerU 文档解析 API 将 PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件、图片及电子表格转为 Markdown。

entries.english: PDF extraction router that classifies each page and routes it to PyMuPDF, Docling, OCR or an LLM fallback, re-extracting pages with low confidence scores.
entries.zh: PDF 提取路由器：对每页分类并路由到 PyMuPDF、Docling、OCR 或 LLM 回退，对低置信度页面重新提取。

entries.english: Web search for AI via Parallel.
entries.zh: 通过 Parallel 为 AI 提供网页搜索。

entries.english: Unified web layer for agents: multi-engine search including Gemini Grounded Search, stealth browsing, cookie auth and actions across many platforms.
entries.zh: 面向智能体的统一网页层：多引擎搜索（包括 Gemini Grounded Search）、隐蔽浏览、cookie 认证及跨多平台操作。

entries.english: Deep research and batch task execution via Parallel.
entries.zh: 通过 Parallel 进行深度研究和批量任务执行。

entries.english: Extract structured data from invoices, receipts, purchase orders, bank statements and other documents with ParserBee Parser Templates, returned as JSON.
entries.zh: 使用 ParserBee Parser Templates 从发票、收据、采购订单、银行对账单等文档中提取结构化数据，返回 JSON。

entries.english: Search GOV.UK content, retrieve full government pages, look up organisations and resolve UK postcodes to local authorities. Read-only.
entries.zh: 搜索 GOV.UK 内容、获取完整政府页面、查询机构，并将英国邮编解析到地方政府。只读。

entries.english: Natural language API discovery: search API capabilities and get endpoints, auth setup and code snippets, with auto-discovery of new APIs.
entries.zh: 自然语言 API 发现：搜索 API 能力并获取端点、认证设置和代码片段，自动发现新 API。

entries.english: Managed Apache Solr: hybrid BM25 and kNN plus semantic search, document ingestion with server-side embeddings, grounded RAG answers and index management.
entries.zh: 托管 Apache Solr：BM25 和 kNN 混合及语义搜索、使用服务器端嵌入导入文档、基于来源的 RAG 回答和索引管理。

entries.english: Search and retrieve web crawler data from WARC, wget, Katana, SiteOne and InterroBot crawls.
entries.zh: 搜索并获取 WARC、wget、Katana、SiteOne 和 InterroBot 抓取的网页爬虫数据。

entries.english: Search the Feedbagel RSS catalog, follow feeds and route new entries to webhooks.
entries.zh: 搜索 Feedbagel RSS 目录、关注信息流，并将新条目路由到 webhook。

entries.english: Web data via residential proxies: page scraping to Markdown, SERP search, site crawl and map, ready-made collectors and datasets from plain-language prompts.
entries.zh: 通过住宅代理获取网页数据：将页面抓取为 Markdown、SERP 搜索、站点爬取和映射，以及根据自然语言提示生成现成采集器和数据集。

entries.english: German public procurement data (OCDS): semantic search, tender matching against company profiles and structured filtering.
entries.zh: 德国公共采购数据（OCDS）：语义搜索、将招标与公司资料匹配及结构化筛选。

entries.english: Unofficial access to the Catalysis Hub database: search and retrieve computational catalysis research and surface reaction data.
entries.zh: 非官方 Catalysis Hub 数据库访问：搜索和获取计算催化研究及表面反应数据。

entries.english: Search Dutch Parliament (Tweede Kamer) documents, debates, activities and legislative cases, based on the OpenTK project.
entries.zh: 基于 OpenTK 项目搜索荷兰议会（Tweede Kamer）文档、辩论、活动和立法案件。

entries.english: Autonomous deep research with structured query elaboration and concise reporting.
entries.zh: 通过结构化查询细化和简明报告开展自主深度研究。

entries.english: Local, offline full-text code search for coding agents using a trigram index over large codebases.
entries.zh: 面向编码智能体的本地离线全文代码搜索，对大型代码库使用 trigram 索引。

entries.english: Token-efficient web fetching for Japanese sites: outline-first disclosure, Shift_JIS and EUC-JP decoding, PDF and CSV extraction and polite crawling.
entries.zh: 面向日本网站、节省 token 的网页获取：先展示大纲、解码 Shift_JIS 和 EUC-JP、提取 PDF 和 CSV，并进行礼貌爬取。

entries.english: Access computational knowledge and data via the Wolfram Alpha API.
entries.zh: 通过 Wolfram Alpha API 访问计算知识和数据。

entries.english: Read-only web search via DuckDuckGo Lite, image search via Bing Images and page-to-Markdown scraping with a readability extractor.
entries.zh: 通过 DuckDuckGo Lite 只读搜索网页、通过 Bing Images 搜索图片，并使用可读性提取器将页面抓取为 Markdown。

entries.english: Search products and nearby physical stores to buy locally instead of waiting for delivery.
entries.zh: 搜索商品和附近实体店，在本地购买而无需等待配送。

entries.english: Parallel search across GitHub, npm, PyPI, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Hacker News, Reddit, X, Dev.to, Hashnode, Qiita and Zenn with structured JSON output.
entries.zh: 并行搜索 GitHub、npm、PyPI、arXiv、Semantic Scholar、Hacker News、Reddit、X、Dev.to、Hashnode、Qiita 和 Zenn，输出结构化 JSON。

entries.english: Measure how independently a claim is reported, with syndication-aware source counting and 0-1 confidence scores. Measures corroboration, not truth.
entries.zh: 衡量一项主张被独立报道的程度，计算考虑转载关系的来源数量并给出 0–1 置信度评分。衡量的是相互印证程度，而非真实性。

entries.english: Web scraping via ScraperAPI with JavaScript rendering, geotargeting, premium proxies and auto-parsing.
entries.zh: 通过 ScraperAPI 抓取网页，支持 JavaScript 渲染、地理定向、高级代理和自动解析。

entries.english: B2B lead generation: Apollo and Google Maps data, email finding and validation, mobile number lookup, skip tracing and ecommerce store data.
entries.zh: B2B 线索生成：Apollo 和 Google Maps 数据、查找与验证邮箱、查询手机号码、寻找失联人员及电商商店数据。

entries.english: Manage Searchcraft clusters, create search indexes, generate an index from a data file and import data from a feed or local JSON file.
entries.zh: 管理 Searchcraft 集群、创建搜索索引、从数据文件生成索引，并从信息流或本地 JSON 文件导入数据。

entries.english: OpenGraph.io API: extract OG metadata, take screenshots, scrape web content, query sites with AI and generate branded images and social cards.
entries.zh: OpenGraph.io API：提取 OG 元数据、截取截图、抓取网页内容、用 AI 查询网站，以及生成品牌图片和社交卡片。

entries.english: Domain availability checks, registrar price comparison and domain age lookups across many TLDs.
entries.zh: 跨多个顶级域名检查域名可用性、比较注册商价格及查询域名年龄。

entries.english: Query and retrieve topic-specific knowledge from recursively crawled and indexed web pages via Driflyte.
entries.zh: 通过 Driflyte 查询并获取递归爬取及索引的网页中的特定主题知识。

entries.english: Search results from Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, YouTube, eBay and more via SerpApi, plus real-time weather and stock market data.
entries.zh: 通过 SerpApi 获取 Google、Bing、Yahoo、DuckDuckGo、YouTube、eBay 等搜索结果，并提供实时天气和股票市场数据。

entries.english: Web search returning extracted page content (URL, title, date, text) instead of links, with automatic localization and an optional synthesized answer.
entries.zh: 网页搜索直接返回提取的页面内容（URL、标题、日期、文本），而非链接；支持自动本地化和可选综合回答。

entries.english: Search, documentation retrieval, code analysis and architecture research powered by Google's Vertex AI or the Gemini API.
entries.zh: 由 Google Vertex AI 或 Gemini API 驱动的搜索、文档获取、代码分析和架构研究。

entries.english: ShopSavvy product and price data: search by barcode, ASIN or URL, get product details, compare retailer prices and track price history.
entries.zh: ShopSavvy 商品和价格数据：按条形码、ASIN 或 URL 搜索，获取商品详情、比较零售商价格并跟踪价格历史。

entries.english: Extract typed, schema-defined records from any document and query them in natural language like a database.
entries.zh: 从任意文档提取按 schema 定义的类型化记录，并像数据库一样使用自然语言查询。

entries.english: Search companies' public Ashby job boards: resolve a company to its board, filter openings, read full postings and compare published pay ranges.
entries.zh: 搜索公司的公开 Ashby 招聘页面：将公司解析到其招聘页面、筛选职位、阅读完整职位信息并比较公开薪资范围。

entries.english: Search the Anime News Network encyclopedia for anime and manga, read cast, staff, episodes and studios as compact rows, and follow the news wire.
entries.zh: 在 Anime News Network 百科中搜索动画和漫画，以精简行读取演员、工作人员、剧集和制作公司，并关注新闻信息流。

entries.english: Search Marmiton recipes, read ingredients and steps, and rescale quantities to any number of servings.
entries.zh: 搜索 Marmiton 食谱，阅读食材和步骤，并按任意份数调整用量。

entries.english: Read Spanish family recipes from Pequerecetas, rescale servings and browse by diet, main ingredient, appliance or age group from six months up.
entries.zh: 阅读 Pequerecetas 的西班牙家庭食谱，按份数调整，并按饮食、主要食材、电器或六个月以上的年龄组浏览。

entries.english: Web and image search, page reading as Markdown, browser-rendered screenshots, schema-based extraction and deep research, with strong Russian web coverage.
entries.zh: 网页和图片搜索、以 Markdown 阅读页面、浏览器渲染截图、基于 schema 的提取和深度研究，对俄语网页覆盖较强。

entries.english: Crawl documentation sites into local Markdown or JSONL corpora and serve them with offline BM25 search, page reads, freshness checks and crawl diffs.
entries.zh: 将文档网站爬取为本地 Markdown 或 JSONL 语料库，并提供离线 BM25 搜索、页面读取、新鲜度检查和爬取差异。

entries.english: Search rescue dogs from European and UK organizations, with detailed profiles and personality matching.
entries.zh: 搜索欧洲和英国救助组织的待领养犬只，提供详细资料和性格匹配。

entries.english: Get the LaTeX source of arXiv papers to handle mathematical content and equations.
entries.zh: 获取 arXiv 论文的 LaTeX 源码，以处理数学内容和公式。

entries.english: Schema-validated extraction of structured fields from PDFs, scans, images and forms, with searchable memory of past extractions.
entries.zh: 从 PDF、扫描件、图片和表单中提取符合 schema 验证的结构化字段，并可搜索以往提取结果。

entries.english: Search and count job postings from 185 sources in 250 countries (~8M new per month) via Techmap's Jobs API; filters for title, skills, company, city, remote/hybrid, salary and posting date.
entries.zh: 通过 Techmap Jobs API 搜索和统计来自 250 个国家、185 个来源的招聘信息（每月约 800 万条新增），可按职位、技能、公司、城市、远程／混合、薪资和发布日期筛选。

entries.english: Multi-engine parallel web search with re-ranking that works within China's network without a proxy or VPN.
entries.zh: 无需代理或 VPN 即可在中国网络内运行的多引擎并行网页搜索，支持重排。

entries.english: Retrieve and process news from GeekNews.
entries.zh: 获取并处理 GeekNews 新闻。

entries.english: Query articles, statistics, the wire feed, comments, citations and agent leaderboards from The Agent Times, a newspaper covering the agent economy.
entries.zh: 查询报道智能体经济的报纸 The Agent Times 的文章、统计、通讯信息流、评论、引用和智能体排行榜。

entries.english: Gene set enrichment analysis using the Enrichr API.
entries.zh: 使用 Enrichr API 进行基因集富集分析。

entries.english: Data extraction with AgentQL.
entries.zh: 使用 AgentQL 提取数据。

entries.english: Search a catalog of AI tools, compare them, find alternatives and check whether a tool is active, defunct or acquired.
entries.zh: 搜索 AI 工具目录、比较工具、寻找替代方案，并检查工具处于活跃、停用还是被收购状态。

entries.english: Live trend data from Google, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Reddit, npm, Steam and other sources.
entries.zh: 来自 Google、TikTok、YouTube、Amazon、Reddit、npm、Steam 等来源的实时趋势数据。

entries.english: Fetch bot-protected and JavaScript-heavy pages, choosing plain HTTP or a real browser per site, and parse supported pages into JSON with published templates. Runs locally via npx or hosted at mcp.unblockingapi.com.
entries.zh: 获取有机器人防护或大量 JavaScript 的页面，按网站选择普通 HTTP 或真实浏览器，并使用已发布模板将支持的页面解析为 JSON。可通过 npx 本地运行，也可使用 mcp.unblockingapi.com 托管服务。

entries.english: Generate and manage screenshots, PDFs and videos, analyze screenshots with AI and extract web content as Markdown, metadata or HTML via the Urlbox API.
entries.zh: 通过 Urlbox API 生成和管理截图、PDF 及视频，使用 AI 分析截图，并将网页内容提取为 Markdown、元数据或 HTML。

entries.english: Self-hostable web crawler and search API (fastCRW): scraping, crawling, site mapping and SearXNG-backed search.
entries.zh: 可自托管的网页爬虫和搜索 API（fastCRW）：抓取、爬取、网站映射和基于 SearXNG 的搜索。

entries.english: Resolve an agent's intent to the right MCP server across registries, with an invocation-ready snippet and an Ed25519-signed trust passport.
entries.zh: 跨注册中心将智能体意图匹配到合适的 MCP 服务器，提供可直接调用的片段和 Ed25519 签名信任凭证。

entries.english: NCBI and PubMed literature search with analytics, caching, MeSH integration, related article discovery and batch processing for life sciences research.
entries.zh: 面向生命科学研究的 NCBI 和 PubMed 文献搜索，支持分析、缓存、MeSH 集成、相关文章发现及批处理。

entries.english: Reptile and exotic pet knowledge base: species identification, genetics calculator, care information, health diagnosis, prices and blockchain provenance.
entries.zh: 爬行动物和异宠知识库：物种识别、遗传计算器、饲养信息、健康诊断、价格和区块链来源记录。

entries.english: Multi-provider web search with automatic routing between Serper, Tavily and Exa.
entries.zh: 多服务商网页搜索，在 Serper、Tavily 和 Exa 之间自动路由。

entries.english: Web search, content extraction, screenshots, weather, finance, email validation, translation, news, GeoIP, WHOIS, DNS, PDF extraction and QR codes.
entries.zh: 网页搜索、内容提取、截图、天气、金融、邮箱验证、翻译、新闻、GeoIP、WHOIS、DNS、PDF 提取和二维码。

entries.english: Web data extraction and scraping via WebScraping.ai.
entries.zh: 通过 WebScraping.ai 提取和抓取网页数据。

entries.english: License-aware federated image search across many providers, returning license tags, attribution strings, dimensions and download URLs.
entries.zh: 跨多个服务商的许可感知联邦图片搜索，返回许可标签、署名文本、尺寸和下载 URL。

entries.english: List, fetch and full-text search structured daily AI news from AI Daily Insights, a Chinese AI-industry briefing.
entries.zh: 列出、获取并全文搜索 AI Daily Insights 的结构化每日 AI 新闻；这是中文 AI 行业简报。

entries.english: Self-contained SearXNG in Docker: metasearch across many engines and categories with multi-page fanout, autocomplete, engine discovery and a Web UI proxy.
entries.zh: Docker 中的独立 SearXNG：跨多个引擎和类别进行元搜索，支持多页并发、自动补全、引擎发现和 Web UI 代理。

entries.english: Local-first Bilibili MCP server for video metadata, subtitles and structured transcripts, chapters, popular comments, and optional local ASR fallback. Published on npm as `@xzxzzx/bilibili-mcp` with bilingual documentation.
entries.zh: 本地优先的 Bilibili MCP 服务器：视频元数据、字幕和结构化转录、章节、热门评论，以及可选本地 ASR 回退。以 `@xzxzzx/bilibili-mcp` 发布到 npm，提供双语文档。

entries.english: Ad-free web scraping and search as clean Markdown: fetch pages singly or in parallel batches, and search the web for top-k pages.
entries.zh: 无广告网页抓取与搜索，输出干净 Markdown：可单个或并行批量获取页面，并搜索排名前 k 的页面。

entries.english: Web search via DuckDuckGo.
entries.zh: 通过 DuckDuckGo 搜索网页。

entries.english: Web search via Google, Brave, Serper, SearXNG and SearchAPI.io, multi-tier content extraction, academic and patent search, and multi-source research.
entries.zh: 通过 Google、Brave、Serper、SearXNG 和 SearchAPI.io 搜索网页，支持多级内容提取、学术和专利搜索及多来源研究。

entries.english: Fetch YouTube transcripts in text, JSON, SRT or WebVTT format and in multiple languages, and optionally summarize them.
entries.zh: 以文本、JSON、SRT 或 WebVTT 多语言格式获取 YouTube 转录，并可选择生成摘要。

entries.english: Full-text PDF search with Apple Vision OCR via the PDF Content Search app, with date, category, sender and amount filters, wildcards and boolean operators.
entries.zh: 通过 PDF Content Search 应用使用 Apple Vision OCR 对 PDF 全文搜索，支持日期、类别、发件人及金额筛选、通配符和布尔运算符。

entries.english: Semantic search over the StitchAPI documentation, returning relevant sections with deep links and full pages.
entries.zh: 对 StitchAPI 文档进行语义搜索，返回带深链接的相关章节及完整页面。

entries.english: Self-hosted web research: SearXNG search with DuckDuckGo fallback, crawling, dense and BM25 reranking and deduplication into a cited, source-grounded prompt.
entries.zh: 自托管网页研究：SearXNG 搜索及 DuckDuckGo 回退、爬取、稠密与 BM25 重排和去重，生成带引用、基于来源的提示词。

entries.english: 17 data tools backed by Apify Actors: Google Flights and Hotels prices, Google Shopping, News, Images, Videos, Jobs and Trends, YouTube transcripts, Google Maps leads, Ads Transparency, app reviews and AI-search visibility; pay per result with a spending cap on every run.
entries.zh: 由 Apify Actors 支持的 17 个数据工具：Google Flights 和 Hotels 价格、Google Shopping、News、Images、Videos、Jobs 和 Trends、YouTube 转录、Google Maps 线索、Ads Transparency、应用评论及 AI 搜索可见度；按结果付费，每次运行均有支出上限。

entries.english: Search Ptitchef recipes, browse ingredient categories, read ingredients, method, cost and nutrition, find dishes from fridge contents and rescale servings.
entries.zh: 搜索 Ptitchef 食谱、浏览食材类别、阅读食材／做法／成本／营养，根据冰箱食材寻找菜肴并按份数调整。

entries.english: Search BBC Good Food recipes, read them in the original or US version, see accepted search facet values and rescale to any number of people.
entries.zh: 搜索 BBC Good Food 食谱，阅读原版或美式版本、查看可用搜索筛选值并按任意人数调整。

entries.english: Read Supertoinette's French recipes: ingredients, steps, difficulty, cost, resting time and wine pairings, and rescale to any number of people.
entries.zh: 阅读 Supertoinette 法国食谱：食材、步骤、难度、成本、静置时间和葡萄酒搭配，并按任意人数调整。

entries.english: Search, page reading, images, screenshots and multi-source answers over your own SearXNG, reporting which engines were queried and what to distrust.
entries.zh: 通过自己的 SearXNG 进行搜索、页面阅读、图片、截图和多来源回答，并报告查询了哪些引擎及哪些内容不宜信任。

entries.english: Official MCP Server for BoltPatternHQ providing AI assistants with instant automotive wheel fitment, PCD, center bore, and offset reference data.
entries.zh: BoltPatternHQ 官方 MCP 服务器，为 AI 助手提供即时汽车轮毂适配、PCD、中心孔和偏距参考数据。

entries.english: Stealth web scraper bypassing Cloudflare anti-bot via Scrapling, extracts clean DOM to Markdown, and sanitizes prompt injections with x402 micropayments on Base.
entries.zh: 使用 Scrapling 绕过 Cloudflare 反机器人防护的隐蔽网页抓取器，将干净 DOM 提取为 Markdown 并清理提示注入；通过 Base 上的 x402 微支付付费。

entries.english: MCP server for WorkAtAStartup — search startup job listings via Claude or Cursor.
entries.zh: 面向 WorkAtAStartup 的 MCP 服务器，可通过 Claude 或 Cursor 搜索创业公司职位。

entries.english: Verifies an artifact an AI agent produced (JSON, code, structured output) against a JSON Schema plus positional prompt-injection checks, returning a verdict with reasons before you accept the result. x402-paid with a free tier of 20 checks/day.
entries.zh: 根据 JSON Schema 和位置性提示注入检查验证 AI 智能体生成的产物（JSON、代码、结构化输出），在接受结果前返回带原因的判定。通过 x402 付费，免费层每天 20 次检查。

entries.english: Policy sidecar for any MCP server: deny-by-default tool allowlist with argument rules, call and USD budget caps, and a hash-chained audit log with RFC 3161 timestamp anchors. Also usable as a TypeScript or Python library.
entries.zh: 适用于任意 MCP 服务器的策略边车：默认拒绝的工具允许列表、参数规则、调用与美元预算上限，以及带 RFC 3161 时间戳锚点的哈希链审计日志。也可作为 TypeScript 或 Python 库使用。

entries.english: One local gate for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and Antigravity: allow, deny and ask rules over MCP and built-in tool calls, approvals from a terminal UI, and hash-chained receipts.
entries.zh: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot CLI 和 Antigravity 的统一本地关卡：对 MCP 和内置工具调用设置允许、拒绝与询问规则，通过终端界面审批，并生成哈希链记录。

entries.english: Claim-level hallucination detection with sources, agent trajectory verification, risk gating for computer-use actions and prompt-injection defense.
entries.zh: 逐项主张幻觉检测并提供来源、智能体轨迹验证、计算机操作的风险关卡和提示注入防护。

entries.english: Stdio proxy that pins every tool definition (name, description, input schema, annotations) when you approve a server and blocks the session, with a diff, if any of it changes later. Also keeps a public, signed log of tool definition changes across public MCP servers.
entries.zh: STDIO 代理：批准服务器时固定每个工具定义（名称、描述、输入 schema、注释）；此后任一部分发生变化时阻止会话并显示差异。还维护公开 MCP 服务器工具定义变化的公开签名日志。

entries.english: Fail-closed approval layer for unattended agent runs: checks actions against org policy, requests human approval and logs every decision to a causal ledger.
entries.zh: 无人值守智能体运行的故障关闭审批层：根据组织策略检查操作、请求人工批准，并将每项决定记录到因果账本。

entries.english: Install a large security toolset and discover and run it through an authorization-gated server for CTF, pentesting, bug bounty and DFIR.
entries.zh: 安装大型安全工具集，并通过需要授权的服务器发现和运行工具，适用于 CTF、渗透测试、漏洞赏金和数字取证与事故响应。

entries.english: Turn other AIops tools' audit trails into tamper-evident, hash-chained evidence bundles mapped to HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2 and GDPR. Offline and deterministic.
entries.zh: 将其他 AIops 工具的审计轨迹转换为防篡改哈希链证据包，映射到 HIPAA、PCI-DSS、SOC 2 和 GDPR。离线且确定性运行。

entries.english: Self-hosted OWASP ZAP integration with guided security scans, findings summaries and report generation.
entries.zh: 自托管 OWASP ZAP 集成：提供引导式安全扫描、发现摘要和报告生成。

entries.english: Governed OPNsense + pfSense firewall operations — gateway-health, rule-shadow, and blocked-traffic RCA, plus guardrailed rule/alias writes (35 tools) with unbypassable audit logging (MCP + CLI), budget/runaway guards, dry-run, and undo/rollback.
entries.zh: 受治理的 OPNsense 与 pfSense 防火墙操作：网关健康、规则遮蔽和被阻流量根因分析，以及受保护的规则／别名写入（35 个工具）；提供不可绕过的审计日志（MCP + CLI）、预算／失控防护、试运行和撤销／回滚。

entries.english: Payment guardrails for AI agents: spend caps, budget and approval gates, prompt-injection defense, an encrypted secret vault and an audit trail.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的支付防护：支出上限、预算与审批关卡、提示注入防御、加密秘密保管库和审计轨迹。

entries.english: Self-hosted security layer that evaluates AI agents' proposed blockchain transactions and returns an explainable allow, warn or block decision.
entries.zh: 自托管安全层：评估 AI 智能体提出的区块链交易，返回可解释的允许、警告或阻止决定。

entries.english: EVM bytecode capability analysis, EIP-1967 proxy resolution, gas recommendations and preflight safety checks for agents on Base.
entries.zh: 面向 Base 上智能体的 EVM 字节码能力分析、EIP-1967 代理解析、gas 建议和预执行安全检查。

entries.english: Deterministic sub-0.2ms AST security circuit breaker and proxy for MCP tool call dispatch pipelines.
entries.zh: 用于 MCP 工具调用分发流水线的确定性 AST 安全断路器和代理，延迟低于 0.2 毫秒。

entries.english: Malcolm threat hunting: search and aggregate network traffic, query Suricata alerts, browse Arkime sessions and resolve NetBox assets. Read-only by default.
entries.zh: Malcolm 威胁狩猎：搜索和聚合网络流量、查询 Suricata 告警、浏览 Arkime 会话并解析 NetBox 资产。默认只读。

entries.english: CyberChef MCP server providing 28 core data transformations, ciphers, hashing, JWT decoding, representation-calibrated Shannon entropy, and multi-layer payload deobfuscation for AI coding and security agents. `npx -y @noorfatima123456/cyber-chef-mcp`
entries.zh: CyberChef MCP 服务器，为 AI 编码和安全智能体提供 28 种核心数据转换、密码算法、哈希、JWT 解码、按表示形式校准的香农熵和多层载荷去混淆。`npx -y @noorfatima123456/cyber-chef-mcp`

entries.english: Read-only safety checks for Base and EVM: honeypot and rug-pull detection, risky approvals, verified source, balances, ENS and Basenames, gas and prices.
entries.zh: 面向 Base 和 EVM 的只读安全检查：蜜罐与跑路检测、风险授权、已验证源码、余额、ENS 和 Basenames、gas 和价格。

entries.english: Transparent MCP proxy that keeps a signed, hash-chained audit trail of agent tool calls, with YAML policy enforcement and OpenTelemetry export.
entries.zh: 透明 MCP 代理：对智能体工具调用维护带签名的哈希链审计轨迹，并提供 YAML 策略执行和 OpenTelemetry 导出。

entries.english: JSON risk briefs for wallet addresses, tokens and URLs: scores, flags and sources from phishing, scam and URL-reputation heuristics, including OpenPhish.
entries.zh: 钱包地址、代币和 URL 的 JSON 风险简报：基于网络钓鱼、诈骗和 URL 信誉启发式方法（包括 OpenPhish）提供评分、标记和来源。

entries.english: Local, zero-trust masking of PII and secrets.
entries.zh: 本地零信任掩码个人身份信息和秘密。

entries.english: Supply-chain gate for agent skills and MCP servers: detects poisoned tool definitions, pins servers by hash, checks drift in CI and proxies only pinned tools.
entries.zh: 面向智能体技能和 MCP 服务器的供应链关卡：检测被投毒的工具定义、按哈希固定服务器、在 CI 中检查漂移，并仅代理固定工具。

entries.english: Check lockfiles against malicious-package advisories and scan artifacts for credential theft, exfiltration, obfuscation, prompt injection and droppers.
entries.zh: 对照恶意包公告检查锁文件，并扫描产物中的凭据盗窃、数据外传、混淆、提示注入和投放器。

entries.english: DNS and email security scans via IntoDNS.ai: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNSSEC, MTA-STS, BIMI, TLS, blacklist and deliverability checks plus security header analysis.
entries.zh: 通过 IntoDNS.ai 进行 DNS 和邮件安全扫描：SPF、DKIM、DMARC、DNSSEC、MTA-STS、BIMI、TLS、黑名单及送达率检查，并分析安全响应头。

entries.english: Fail-closed trust gate for agents: fact-checking, prompt-injection detection, content moderation, PII and secret detection, and a pre-action guardrail.
entries.zh: 面向智能体的故障关闭信任关卡：事实核查、提示注入检测、内容审核、个人身份信息和秘密检测及操作前防护。

entries.english: Scan MCP servers and skills before install, vet endpoints before calling them, and run vulnerability scans, threat intel and compliance checks.
entries.zh: 安装前扫描 MCP 服务器和技能、调用前审查端点，并执行漏洞扫描、威胁情报及合规检查。

entries.english: Deterministic audit layer that checks LLM and agent outputs against jailbreak, safety and trading compliance policies and logs verdicts to a hash chain.
entries.zh: 确定性审计层：对照越狱、安全和交易合规策略检查 LLM 与智能体输出，并将判定记录到哈希链。

entries.english: Register and verify domains, queue security scans (headers, TLS, DNS, ports, CVEs and AI-specific checks) and read findings.
entries.zh: 注册和验证域名、将安全扫描（响应头、TLS、DNS、端口、CVE 和 AI 专项检查）加入队列并读取发现结果。

entries.english: Verify IBAN, VAT, VIN, barcodes, national and tax IDs, crypto addresses, phone numbers, dates and holidays against checksums and curated data.
entries.zh: 根据校验和及精选数据验证 IBAN、VAT、VIN、条形码、国家和税务 ID、加密地址、电话号码、日期及节假日。

entries.english: Domain security checks: DNS, DNSSEC, TLS grading, HTTP security headers, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, port scans, ASN, RDAP and WHOIS, plus an overall health score.
entries.zh: 域名安全检查：DNS、DNSSEC、TLS 评级、HTTP 安全响应头、SPF、DKIM 和 DMARC、端口扫描、ASN、RDAP 和 WHOIS，并给出总体健康评分。

entries.english: Agent compliance and identity: verify an agent's X.509 certificate scope, read its behavioral risk score and append to an immutable audit trail.
entries.zh: 智能体合规与身份：验证智能体 X.509 证书的范围、读取其行为风险评分，并追加到不可变审计轨迹。

entries.english: Honeypot threat intelligence from a sensor network: IP reputation, scanner classification, CVE probing trends and JA4, JA4H and HASSH fingerprints.
entries.zh: 来自传感器网络的蜜罐威胁情报：IP 信誉、扫描器分类、CVE 探测趋势和 JA4、JA4H、HASSH 指纹。

entries.english: Infrastructure diagnostics: DNS checks, TLS certificate chain inspection, email security, global DNS propagation and DNS latency benchmarking.
entries.zh: 基础设施诊断：DNS 检查、TLS 证书链检查、邮件安全、全球 DNS 传播及 DNS 延迟基准测试。

entries.english: Cross-repository code knowledge graph for Java, Kotlin, JavaScript and TypeScript: call-flow tracing, taint analysis, reachability and license compliance.
entries.zh: 跨仓库代码知识图谱，支持 Java、Kotlin、JavaScript 和 TypeScript：调用流追踪、污点分析、可达性和许可证合规。

entries.english: Least-privilege compiler for agents: record real tool calls, compile a minimal policy, enforce it at an MCP gateway and keep a hash-chained audit.
entries.zh: 面向智能体的最小权限编译器：记录实际工具调用、编译最小策略、在 MCP 网关执行并维护哈希链审计。

entries.english: SSRF-hardened web gateway with web fetch, web search and Metis verification, sharing an audited security core with Metis and ARGUS.
entries.zh: 强化 SSRF 防护的网页网关，提供网页获取、搜索和 Metis 验证，与 Metis 及 ARGUS 共享经审计的安全核心。

entries.english: Verifiable oracle tools via AIMarket Hub: Platon VRF randomness, Chronos VDF computation and verification, and LUMEN reputation scores.
entries.zh: 通过 AIMarket Hub 提供可验证预言机工具：Platon VRF 随机性、Chronos VDF 计算与验证以及 LUMEN 信誉评分。

entries.english: Query ARGUS-3 and check its status; WARDEN vets third-party MCP servers with a scored firewall, tool-definition pinning and drift detection.
entries.zh: 查询 ARGUS-3 并检查状态；WARDEN 通过评分防火墙、工具定义固定和漂移检测审查第三方 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Cryptographic provenance, blind reputation scoring and tamper-evident logging for agent interactions, with dispute resolution and trust-based matchmaking.
entries.zh: 为智能体交互提供密码学来源证明、盲信誉评分和防篡改日志，并支持争议解决及基于信任的匹配。

entries.english: Redacts emails, phone numbers, national IDs, private keys and financial data before text reaches LLMs, in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German and Japanese.
entries.zh: 在文本到达 LLM 前，遮盖电子邮箱、电话号码、国家身份证号、私钥和财务数据，支持英语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、德语和日语。

entries.english: Real-time security framework for MCP servers that detects and blocks malicious agent behavior by analyzing tool call patterns and intent.
entries.zh: 面向 MCP 服务器的实时安全框架，通过分析工具调用模式和意图来检测并阻止恶意智能体行为。

entries.english: Zero-knowledge password manager and MCP credential gateway: policy-gated agent access, deterministic passwords, BIP-39 recovery and a hash-chain audit trail.
entries.zh: 零知识密码管理器和 MCP 凭据网关：以策略约束智能体访问、确定性密码、BIP-39 恢复及哈希链审计轨迹。

entries.english: Policy-based governance for agent tool calls across LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic and MCP: YAML policies, approval gates, risk assessment and audit logging.
entries.zh: 跨 LangChain、OpenAI、Anthropic 和 MCP 对智能体工具调用进行基于策略的治理：YAML 策略、审批关卡、风险评估和审计日志。

entries.english: Local-first MCP gateway for coding agents that redacts detected secrets from file reads and command output before they reach model context.
entries.zh: 面向编码智能体的本地优先 MCP 网关：在文件读取和命令输出进入模型上下文前遮盖检测到的秘密。

entries.english: Reverse engineering tools from Solvitor: extract IDL files from closed-source Solana smart contracts and decompile them.
entries.zh: Solvitor 逆向工程工具：从闭源 Solana 智能合约中提取 IDL 文件并反编译。

entries.english: Agent identity, scoped delegation and governance: issue passports, verify narrowing-only delegation chains, enforce gateway policy and emit signed records.
entries.zh: 智能体身份、范围限定委派及治理：签发护照、验证权限只能收窄的委派链、执行网关策略并生成签名记录。

entries.english: Verify a photo's capture time and provenance: C2PA Content Credentials validation, EXIF/XMP consistency checks and pixel forensics combined into one verdict.
entries.zh: 验证照片拍摄时间和来源：将 C2PA Content Credentials 验证、EXIF/XMP 一致性检查和像素取证合并为一个判定。

entries.english: Query AgentForge Trust Scores for MCP servers before connecting, covering security, code health, behavioral audit, community trust and EU compliance.
entries.zh: 连接前查询 MCP 服务器的 AgentForge Trust Scores，涵盖安全、代码健康、行为审计、社区信任和欧盟合规。

entries.english: Toxicity scores (0-1) for text before an AI agent posts it: toxicity, severe toxicity, insult, profanity, threat and identity attack. Google Perspective API compatible, deterministic (no LLM).
entries.zh: 在 AI 智能体发布文本前给出毒性评分（0–1）：毒性、严重毒性、侮辱、脏话、威胁和身份攻击。兼容 Google Perspective API，确定性运行（不使用 LLM）。

entries.english: Signed, recomputable safety scores for MCP servers, packages and tools, with offline-verifiable attestations and a GitHub Action to gate CI merges.
entries.zh: 为 MCP 服务器、软件包和工具提供可重新计算的签名安全评分，支持离线验证证明，并提供用于控制 CI 合并的 GitHub Action。

entries.english: Identity and credential broker for MCP servers: issues scoped, short-lived credentials per agent, with audit logging and human approval gates.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器身份与凭据代理：为每个智能体签发有范围限制的短期凭据，并提供审计日志和人工审批关卡。

entries.english: Local guardrail proxy for MCP servers: blocks destructive tool calls, pins tool catalogs against rug pulls and scans for tool poisoning and prompt injection.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器本地防护代理：阻止破坏性工具调用、固定工具目录以防项目方撤换恶意内容，并扫描工具投毒及提示注入。

entries.english: Proof-of-behavior enforcement for AI agents: define permit/forbid/require rules, enforce them at runtime and keep hash-chained, tamper-evident audit logs.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的行为证明执行：定义允许／禁止／要求规则、在运行时执行，并保存哈希链防篡改审计日志。

entries.english: Runtime governance for MCP tool calls that blocks prompt injection and capability abuse before tool results reach the agent.
entries.zh: 对 MCP 工具调用进行运行时治理，在工具结果到达智能体前阻止提示注入和能力滥用。

entries.english: MCP proxy that enforces least-privilege YAML policies on tool calls, classifies PII/PHI, detects dangerous skill chains and generates compliance audit trails.
entries.zh: MCP 代理：对工具调用执行最小权限 YAML 策略，分类 PII／PHI，检测危险技能链并生成合规审计轨迹。

entries.english: Agent discovery and certification with a trust and payment rail: identity verification, escrow, settlement and reputation management.
entries.zh: 带信任和支付基础设施的智能体发现与认证：身份验证、托管、结算和信誉管理。

entries.english: Agent identity registry (reputation, capability search, task marketplace, messaging) plus a local encrypted vault that leases provider keys to agents.
entries.zh: 智能体身份注册表（信誉、能力搜索、任务市场、消息），以及向智能体租借服务商密钥的本地加密保管库。

entries.english: Local security reconnaissance: WHOIS, DNS and subdomain enumeration, Nmap scanning, TLS inspection, tech fingerprinting, CVE and IP reputation lookups.
entries.zh: 本地安全侦察：WHOIS、DNS 和子域名枚举、Nmap 扫描、TLS 检查、技术指纹识别、CVE 和 IP 信誉查询。

entries.english: Trust intelligence for AI agents: identity stamps, reputation scoring, a registry, forensic audit trails and A2A passports via x402 micropayments.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的信任情报：身份印记、信誉评分、注册表、取证审计轨迹和 A2A 护照，通过 x402 微支付付费。

entries.english: Runtime policy enforcement for AI agents that prevents accidental system damage and unauthorized access, with automatic backups before file writes.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的运行时策略执行：防止意外系统损坏和未经授权的访问，在文件写入前自动备份。

entries.english: EU AI Act compliance scanner for Python AI agents (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI) with prompt injection detection, risk classification and fix generation.
entries.zh: 针对 Python AI 智能体（LangChain、CrewAI、AutoGen、OpenAI）的欧盟 AI 法案合规扫描器，提供提示注入检测、风险分类及修复生成。

entries.english: Security intelligence: HIBP password breach checks, email/domain/IP/URL reputation, prompt injection detection and skill supply chain scanning.
entries.zh: 安全情报：HIBP 密码泄露检查、邮箱／域名／IP／URL 信誉、提示注入检测和技能供应链扫描。

entries.english: Security and governance proxy for MCP with YAML policies (blocklists, rate limits, token budgets), token cost tracking, health monitoring and RBAC.
entries.zh: 面向 MCP 的安全与治理代理，支持 YAML 策略（阻止列表、速率限制、token 预算）、token 成本跟踪、健康监控和 RBAC。

entries.english: MCP interceptor that applies one YAML policy (block, require approval, audit, budget cap) to tool calls, also usable in Claude Code hooks and agent SDKs.
entries.zh: MCP 拦截器：对工具调用应用统一 YAML 策略（阻止、要求审批、审计、预算上限），也可用于 Claude Code hooks 和智能体 SDK。

entries.english: Server security auditing and hardening (SSH, firewall, Docker, TLS) with CIS/PCI-DSS/HIPAA mapping, fleet management and forensic evidence collection.
entries.zh: 服务器安全审计和加固（SSH、防火墙、Docker、TLS），提供 CIS/PCI-DSS/HIPAA 映射、设备群管理和取证证据收集。

entries.english: Third-party certifying proxy that signs any HTTP call with an independent Ed25519 signature, RFC 3161 timestamp and Sigstore Rekor anchor.
entries.zh: 第三方认证代理：使用独立 Ed25519 签名、RFC 3161 时间戳和 Sigstore Rekor 锚点签署任意 HTTP 调用。

entries.english: Analyze ROADrecon gather results from Azure tenant enumeration.
entries.zh: 分析 Azure 租户枚举产生的 ROADrecon gather 结果。

entries.english: Identity and credential gateway for agents: Ed25519 identity, encrypted credential vault, OPA policies with audit logging, per-agent memory and web scraping.
entries.zh: 面向智能体的身份和凭据网关：Ed25519 身份、加密凭据保管库、带审计日志的 OPA 策略、按智能体记忆和网页抓取。

entries.english: Deterministic security proxy for MCP that intercepts tool calls, enforces YAML policies, scans for secret leakage and logs everything.
entries.zh: 确定性 MCP 安全代理：拦截工具调用、执行 YAML 策略、扫描秘密泄露并记录全部操作。

entries.english: Security proxy for MCP servers: tool-definition pinning, tool-poisoning and exfiltration detection, injection blocking, secret redaction and audit trails.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器安全代理：工具定义固定、工具投毒及数据外传检测、注入阻止、秘密遮盖和审计轨迹。

entries.english: Risk gate that agents call before irreversible actions, returning a risk score, reversibility class, red flags and a proceed/confirm/human-required decision.
entries.zh: 智能体在不可逆操作前调用的风险关卡，返回风险评分、可逆性类别、危险信号及继续／确认／需要人工的决定。

entries.english: Read-only check of a live URL for publicly exposed secret files: .git, .env, JS source maps, backup/SQL dumps, directory listings and dotfiles.
entries.zh: 只读检查实时 URL 是否公开暴露秘密文件：.git、.env、JavaScript source map、备份／SQL 转储、目录列表和隐藏文件。

entries.english: On-chain trust oracle for ERC-8004 and x402 agents: composite trust scoring, a scam wallet database, ERC-8004 identity lookup and EAS attestations on Base.
entries.zh: 面向 ERC-8004 和 x402 智能体的链上信任预言机：综合信任评分、诈骗钱包数据库、ERC-8004 身份查询及 Base 上的 EAS 证明。

entries.english: Anonymize PII for GDPR in Czech and many other languages using ÚFAL/LINDAT NLP (MasKIT, NameTag), plus morphology, translation and spellcheck.
entries.zh: 使用 ÚFAL/LINDAT NLP（MasKIT、NameTag）为 GDPR 匿名化捷克语和多种其他语言中的个人身份信息，并提供词形分析、翻译和拼写检查。

entries.english: MINT Protocol work attestation for agents: cryptographically attest, verify, rate and discover agent work to build portable on-chain reputation.
entries.zh: 面向智能体的 MINT Protocol 工作证明：以密码学方式证明、验证、评价和发现智能体工作，建立可携带的链上信誉。

entries.english: Official BunkerWeb WAF integration to manage services, instances, IP bans, configurations, plugins, and scheduler jobs over stdio or streamable HTTP.
entries.zh: 官方 BunkerWeb WAF 集成，通过 STDIO 或可流式 HTTP 管理服务、实例、IP 封禁、配置、插件和调度任务。

entries.english: Self-hosted policy enforcement for MCP server fleets: deterministic admission and egress policies, attributable audit logs and SIEM export.
entries.zh: 针对 MCP 服务器群的自托管策略执行：确定性的准入与出站策略、可归属的审计日志和 SIEM 导出。

entries.english: Privacy gateway that sanitizes German and English PII before prompts reach an LLM and issues a signed, timestamped certificate for each call.
entries.zh: 隐私网关：在提示词到达 LLM 前清理德语和英语个人身份信息，并为每次调用签发带时间戳的签名证书。

entries.english: Pre-execution governance for agent tool calls: risk classification, behavioral drift detection, a hold queue for dangerous operations and an audit trail.
entries.zh: 智能体工具调用执行前治理：风险分类、行为漂移检测、危险操作暂缓队列和审计轨迹。

entries.english: Deterministic AI safety policy engine with Z3 formal verification: write, verify and enforce machine-verifiable constraints for AI agents.
entries.zh: 带 Z3 形式化验证的确定性 AI 安全策略引擎：编写、验证并执行 AI 智能体可机器验证的约束。

entries.english: Demonstrates remote attestation of an MCP server running in a Gramine TEE via RA-TLS, so clients can verify the server before connecting.
entries.zh: 演示通过 RA-TLS 对运行在 Gramine TEE 中的 MCP 服务器进行远程证明，使客户端在连接前验证服务器。

entries.english: Core Web Vitals metrics by CMS, CDN and framework, based on Chrome field data and a multi-site crawl.
entries.zh: 基于 Chrome 现场数据和多站点爬取，按 CMS、CDN 和框架提供 Core Web Vitals 指标。

entries.english: OPNsense firewall operations via API: query ARP, DHCP, firewall rules, logs, interfaces, system status and packet captures.
entries.zh: 通过 API 操作 OPNsense 防火墙：查询 ARP、DHCP、防火墙规则、日志、接口、系统状态和数据包捕获。

entries.english: Trust, W3C DID identity and EigenTrust reputation for AI agents, with attestations, disputes, sybil detection and IPFS audit anchoring.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的信任、W3C DID 身份和 EigenTrust 信誉，提供证明、争议处理、女巫攻击检测和 IPFS 审计锚定。

entries.english: HTTP MCP gateway that attaches a principal to tool calls and SSE streams, with allowlists and vault rotation.
entries.zh: HTTP MCP 网关：为工具调用和 SSE 流附加主体身份，支持允许列表和保管库轮换。

entries.english: Trust and risk control plane for AI teams, with phases, routes and a package catalog.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 团队的信任和风险控制平面，包含阶段、路由和软件包目录。

entries.english: AWS security scanner with attack chain detection, breach cost estimation and remediation snippets for CLI and Terraform.
entries.zh: AWS 安全扫描器：检测攻击链、估计泄露成本，并为 CLI 和 Terraform 生成修复片段。

entries.english: Local stdio server that keeps secrets out of coding-agent context: `redact_file` takes a path and returns only redacted content, `scan_secrets` checks staged changes before commit, plus offline webhook signature verification and JWT inspection. No network calls; optional Claude Code hook blocks direct `.env`/private-key reads. Redaction is heuristic.
entries.zh: 本地 STDIO 服务器，避免秘密进入编码智能体上下文：`redact_file` 接收路径并仅返回遮盖后的内容，`scan_secrets` 在提交前检查暂存更改；另提供离线 webhook 签名验证和 JWT 检查。无网络调用；可选 Claude Code hook 阻止直接读取 `.env`／私钥。遮盖基于启发式方法。

entries.english: Local-first AWS security analyzer that discovers attack paths and generates remediations using graph theory.
entries.zh: 本地优先的 AWS 安全分析器，使用图论发现攻击路径并生成修复方案。

entries.english: Permanently redact PII (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, IBANs, card numbers) from PDFs, scans and screenshots, with multilingual OCR.
entries.zh: 通过多语言 OCR 从 PDF、扫描件和截图中永久遮盖个人身份信息（姓名、邮箱、电话号码、地址、IBAN、银行卡号）。

entries.english: Public data lookups: CVE/SBOM security audits, license compliance, patents, federal contracts, NPI providers, nonprofit 990 filings and domain intelligence.
entries.zh: 公共数据查询：CVE/SBOM 安全审计、许可合规、专利、联邦合同、NPI 服务提供者、非营利组织 990 申报和域名情报。

entries.english: Scan and fix a domain's email authentication (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX), blacklist status and domain/SSL expiry, with deterministic, validated fix records.
entries.zh: 扫描并修复域名邮件认证（SPF、DMARC、DKIM、MX）、黑名单状态以及域名／SSL 到期问题，提供确定性且经过验证的修复记录。

entries.english: GCHQ CyberChef's encryption, encoding, compression and forensics operations, plus analysis tools such as hash identification, cipher solving and RSA attacks.
entries.zh: GCHQ CyberChef 的加密、编码、压缩和取证操作，以及哈希识别、密码求解和 RSA 攻击等分析工具。

entries.english: Dead code detection, security scanning and code quality analysis for Python, TypeScript and Go, with AI-assisted remediation.
entries.zh: 面向 Python、TypeScript 和 Go 的死代码检测、安全扫描与代码质量分析，提供 AI 辅助修复。

entries.english: Keyless, read-only CVE and internet-exposure intelligence: CVE lookup and search, CISA KEV, EPSS history, CWE, vendor advisories (MSRC, Red Hat, Cisco, GHSA and more), SBOM and manifest checks, and aggregate exposure radars. Use the hosted endpoint (mcp.echelongraph.io) with no install, or run locally with npx.
entries.zh: 无需密钥的只读 CVE 和互联网暴露情报：CVE 查询与搜索、CISA KEV、EPSS 历史、CWE、厂商公告（MSRC、Red Hat、Cisco、GHSA 等）、SBOM 和清单检查，以及聚合暴露雷达。可免安装使用托管端点 mcp.echelongraph.io，或通过 npx 本地运行。

entries.english: Trust scores and guardrails for AI-generated code: static security rules, Docker-verified build/boot checks and receipts that catch agents lying about tests.
entries.zh: 针对 AI 生成代码的信任评分和防护：静态安全规则、Docker 验证的构建／启动检查，以及可发现智能体虚报测试情况的记录。

entries.english: Local, read-only scanner for GitHub Actions and CI maintenance issues in AI-built apps, with finding explanations and fix plans.
entries.zh: 针对 AI 构建应用中的 GitHub Actions 和 CI 维护问题提供本地只读扫描，并解释发现结果和给出修复计划。

entries.english: Requires a named human's approval before irreversible agent actions such as payments or deploys, then issues an offline-verifiable Ed25519 trust receipt.
entries.zh: 在支付或部署等不可逆智能体操作之前要求指定的人类批准，然后签发可离线验证的 Ed25519 信任记录。

entries.english: URL fetcher and HTML-to-Markdown converter with layered prompt injection defense: hidden-element sanitization, risk scanning and content boundary wrapping.
entries.zh: URL 获取器和 HTML 转 Markdown 工具，提供分层提示注入防御：清理隐藏元素、风险扫描及内容边界包装。

entries.english: Read-only security audit for Supabase. Four tools surface RLS gaps, permissive policies, exposed functions and grants; an `audit` prompt returns scored findings with fix SQL.
entries.zh: 针对 Supabase 的只读安全审计。四个工具揭示 RLS 缺口、宽松策略、暴露函数和授权；`audit` 提示返回带修复 SQL 的评分发现结果。

entries.english: Secrets manager that injects credentials into commands as environment variables so agents never see plaintext secrets, and sanitizes command output.
entries.zh: 秘密管理器：将凭据作为环境变量注入命令，使智能体看不到明文秘密，并清理命令输出。

entries.english: Notarize AI model outputs with signed Ed25519 attestations, SHA-256 content hashes and Merkle anchoring on Base or Solana, paid via x402.
entries.zh: 通过签名 Ed25519 证明、SHA-256 内容哈希及 Base 或 Solana 上的 Merkle 锚定，对 AI 模型输出进行公证，通过 x402 付费。

entries.english: Binary Ninja plugin and bridge for automating binary analysis and reverse engineering.
entries.zh: 用于自动化二进制分析和逆向工程的 Binary Ninja 插件及桥接器。

entries.english: Memory forensics with Volatility 3, exposing plugins such as pslist and netscan through REST APIs.
entries.zh: 使用 Volatility 3 进行内存取证，通过 REST API 暴露 pslist 和 netscan 等插件。

entries.english: Cortex integration for observable analysis and automated security responses.
entries.zh: Cortex 集成，用于可观测对象分析和自动安全响应。

entries.english: TheHive integration for collaborative security incident response and case management.
entries.zh: TheHive 集成，用于协作式安全事故响应和案件管理。

entries.english: Access real-time security alerts and event data from Wazuh SIEM.
entries.zh: 访问 Wazuh SIEM 的实时安全告警和事件数据。

entries.english: Credential isolation proxy that injects secrets at the network boundary, with domain restrictions, agent authentication and audit logging.
entries.zh: 凭据隔离代理：在网络边界注入秘密，并提供域名限制、智能体认证和审计日志。

entries.english: HTTP security testing toolkit (send, intruder, race, chain, out-of-band) with low-level HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 control: raw framing and connection pinning.
entries.zh: HTTP 安全测试工具箱（发送、入侵、竞态、链式和带外测试），提供底层 HTTP/1.1 和 HTTP/2 控制，包括原始帧和连接固定。

entries.english: Agent identity, trust and audit trails: Ed25519 agent registration, permission checks, tamper-evident audit events, trust scores and credential delegation.
entries.zh: 智能体身份、信任和审计轨迹：Ed25519 智能体注册、权限检查、防篡改审计事件、信任评分和凭据委派。

entries.english: Domain and URL security analysis with GridinSoft Inspector to verify website and link safety.
entries.zh: 使用 GridinSoft Inspector 分析域名和 URL 安全性，验证网站及链接安全。

entries.english: Security scanner for vibe-coded apps (Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, Prisma and more): taint analysis, auto-fix, SARIF export, pre-commit hook and CVE detection.
entries.zh: 面向凭感觉编码的应用（Next.js、Supabase、Stripe、Prisma 等）的安全扫描器：污点分析、自动修复、SARIF 导出、提交前 hook 和 CVE 检测。

entries.english: Runtime policy enforcement for AI agents: evaluate actions against organization policies before execution, in observe or enforce mode.
entries.zh: 针对 AI 智能体执行运行时策略：在执行前按组织策略评估操作，支持观察或执行模式。

entries.english: Locally scans AI-generated code for invisible Unicode, Trojan Source, homoglyphs, rules file backdoors and typosquatting using static analysis and CodeBERT.
entries.zh: 使用静态分析和 CodeBERT 在本地扫描 AI 生成代码中的不可见 Unicode、Trojan Source、同形字符、规则文件后门及拼写抢注。

entries.english: Query the NIST National Vulnerability Database (NVD) API.
entries.zh: 查询 NIST 国家漏洞数据库（NVD）API。

entries.english: Document forensics via the Tamperlens API: detect post-creation edits, failed redactions and embedded prompt injection in PDFs, Office files and images.
entries.zh: 通过 Tamperlens API 进行文档取证：检测 PDF、Office 文件和图片创建后的编辑、失败的遮盖以及嵌入式提示注入。

entries.english: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) directory, user, group, device, sign-in and security operations via Microsoft Graph.
entries.zh: 通过 Microsoft Graph 操作 Microsoft Entra ID（Azure AD）目录、用户、组、设备、登录和安全功能。

entries.english: Quantum-inspired keyring for AI coding agents, securing secrets with superposition, entanglement, tunneling and teleportation.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编码智能体的量子启发式密钥环，使用叠加、纠缠、隧穿和传送来保护秘密。

validation: 范围 3401–4250 应译 751 项；ID 唯一、与索引一致，英文描述逐字匹配固定快照，行内代码均保留。
